Project Manager
Sr Project Manager - Healthcare Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

About the Role:

As a Sr Project Manager, you will be responsible for providing consulting services to an assigned market or high-profile client accounts to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives.

This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. This person must be located in California, will work remote, and travel up to 30%.

What You’ll Do:

Manage all areas of project management for multiple healthcare projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
Work directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project. This includes the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & milestones, quality control, and risk identification.
Define the project delivery resources from pre-qualified lists or through the project qualification process. Conduct complex requests for proposals, complete bid evaluations, and recommend resources to clients.
Facilitate the development of a charter and integrated timeline.
Ensure all functions remain on schedule and issues get resolved or escalated.
Facilitate regular meetings to review project status for active and pending projects.
Collaborate to develop solutions and guide the project team through implementation and completion.
Apply advanced knowledge to seek and develop new, better methods for accomplishing both individual and department objectives.
Showcase expertise in own job discipline and in-depth knowledge of other job disciplines within the organization function.
Coach others to develop in-depth knowledge and expertise in most or all areas within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Anticipates potential objections and persuades others, often at senior levels and of divergent interest, to adopt a different point of view.
Impact the achievement of customer, operational, project, or service objectives across multi-discipline teams. Work is guided by functional policies which impact the design of procedures and policies.
Contribute to new products, processes, standards, and/or operational plans in support of achieving functional goals.
Communicate difficult and complex ideas with the ability to influence.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree preferred with 8-10 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
The innovative mentality to develop methods that go beyond existing solutions.
Ability to solve unique problems using standard and innovative solutions having a broad impact on the business.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Expert organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mindset.
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Additional Information

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At E Tech Group
, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We’re one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 25 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals, Material Handling, Consumer Products and Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We are seeking a Project Manager
to lead a large project or multiple project efforts, which may include subcontractors, high dollar value material content and multiple resources within the Mission Critical Industry. Your responsibilities will include the management and coordination of the design, procurement, implementation, and commissioning phases of projects, including the commercial, financial, and technical success of projects.

You will take a leadership role in developing project proposals and vetting project cost estimates. You will develop and communicate a clear understanding of the client’s project goals and maintain the company’s alignment to these goals, enabling your team to exceed client expectations and budgeted profitability.

This is a remote positon with 30-50% travel expectations.

As a Project Manager, You Will:

Lead Proposal Development – Participate in proposal scope, schedule, and cost estimates, as well as Project Management methodology and project pricing and structure. Prepare for a successful handoff from Business Development.
Manage Client Communication – Ensure effective communication between the client, the project team, Business Development, and the management team at all phases of the project. Be effective at resolving scope, schedule and cost issues as they arise.
Project Schedule and Plan – Develop the project labor resource plan and procurement plan to meet the client’s schedule objective and project cash flow requirements.
Drive Scope – Maintain firm control of scope and compliance with specifications and contract requirements. Ensure that scope is well defined and communicated, and proactively obtain any required Change Orders, develop additional scope opportunities which may serve the client’s objective.
Maintain Cost – Develop and maintain project cost budgets and reports; manage estimated cost at completion, earned value, and contingency. Forecast monthly project costs avoiding cost overruns.
Lead the Project Team – Lead the project team in achieving the project tasks and milestones on schedule and under budget. Work closely with the Operations group to ensure that the right resources are assigned to the project at the optimal time. Communicate project progress to the team and to the client and be an effective advocate for the project team. Identify project risks in advance and mobilize the necessary resources to mitigate risks.
Present regular project activity and financial updates on projects to large audiences of customers and/or internal associates/management/Executives.
Become proficient in the extensive use of the E TECH GROUP PMO Methods, Tools and Process specific to project management standards.
Participate in the implementation of new project management tools that will be utilized across the enterprise.
Develop a strong level of understanding of E TECH GROUP’s Project Management Life (PMLC) Cycle Stages.
Ability to travel 30-50%.
Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

You Have:

BS Engineering degree or equivalent education/experience background.
At least 3 years of dedicated project management experience or 5+ years in a project engineering environment.
Proficient in the utilization of project management principles, methods, and tools.
Ability to implement Project Management Institute (PMI) based standards into the E TECH GROUP culture, and serve as a mentor to other associates.
Proven project leadership on difficult projects, applications, solutions, and situations.
Proven performance in a stressful environment.
Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills.
The ability to utilize technology to lead geographically dispersed project teams.
Experience managing contracts and/or subcontractors.
Experienced in the use of project management software such as MS Project.
Familiarity with industrial controls projects.
Experience with project budget / fiscal accountability.
A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

You May Have:

Controls Engineering background.
Experience with true design projects (EOR).
PMP Certified preferred
Experience with Procore, CXAlloy, and Smartsheet

Benefits & Perks:

401k + match + prompt enrollment.  E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Center Build and Design
jobs.description:
About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.

About The Role

The Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Center Build and Design
role is the program management seat for how TensorWave delivers a single, high-stakes campus.

You will be the dedicated Technical Program Manager anchored to one of our largest data centers, a 100 MW or above deployment carrying a significant share of our committed capacity. You run the thirteen gate delivery framework for that site end to end: site qualification, basis of design, design freeze, permitting and long lead commitment, construction mobilization, substantial completion, energization, commissioning, turnover to operations, and into revenue service. Where the Director owns the framework and the portfolio view across every site, you own the day to day truth of delivery on the site in front of you.

You own the program on your site: the integrated schedule, the cross-functional dependencies, the gate packages, the risk register, and the honest status your Director and the executive team can act on without re-verifying it. This is a maximum leverage, minimum direct authority role. Your influence comes from cadence, written discipline, and being the person on site whose read on the schedule everyone trusts.

What You’ll Do

Phase gate execution. Run the thirteen gate delivery structure for your assigned campus, across every active data hall or delivery phase on that site. Gate package quality, review cadence, three outcome discipline (pass, conditional pass with a dated owner, or hold with a scheduled re-review), and conditional pass tracking to closure. No waived gates, including turnover acceptance by Operations.
Site-level integrated schedule. Own the design and build layer of the integrated schedule for your campus: critical path logic, gate milestones, interlocks between whitespace design and facility design freeze, long lead procurement commitments, and fit-out sequencing in completed zones. Produce site status that rolls up cleanly into the portfolio view the Director and executive leadership rely on.
General contractor and colocation partner coordination. Hold the general contractor, landlord, and vendor bench on your site to scope, schedule, and deliverable quality day to day. Manage the interface milestone discipline for colocation sites, where early gates are landlord controlled but readiness reviews, acceptance, and service readiness are not.
On-site risk and issue management. Maintain the risk register and decision log for your campus. Identify delivery blockers early, drive them to resolution at your level, and escalate to the Director with options and a recommendation attached when a blocker requires portfolio level or executive intervention.
Cross-functional coordination. Be the single point of coordination between Construction Engineering and Design, MEP Engineering, Network, and Operations for everything happening on your site, so each function sees one integrated plan rather than five disconnected ones.
Feeding the playbook. Capture cycle time data per gate on your site, flag what worked and what did not while it is fresh, and feed lessons back into the Director and the shared delivery playbook so the next site benefits from what you learned on this one.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

5 to 8 years in technical program management or delivery roles, with direct, hands-on ownership of data center design and construction delivery.
Experience taking at least one large scale data center or multi-phase campus from design through commissioning and into service.
Working fluency with stage gate delivery governance: written entry criteria, gate packages, and decision records rather than status meetings alone.
Personal fluency in schedule logic at Primavera P6 grade or equivalent, critical path analysis, risk register discipline, and decision logs. You do not delegate the truth of the schedule to someone else.
Working depth across data center infrastructure: power architecture (utility feeds, generators, UPS, switchgear, PDU, busway), cooling including liquid cooling for high density deployments, structured cabling and fiber plant, and commissioning level structures from factory acceptance through integrated systems testing.
Demonstrated ability to hold general contractors and vendors accountable without direct authority over them.
Clear, structured written and verbal communication. You escalate early, in writing, with a recommendation attached.
Expect regular travel to your assigned construction site, at minimum monthly, with extended on-site presence during energization and commissioning windows. Estimated travel is 30 to 40 percent, weighted toward critical delivery milestones.

Preferred Qualifications

CDCDP, CDCP, or equivalent formal data center certification.
Experience delivering AI density whitespace: high kW per rack halls, direct liquid cooling integration, and pod to power granularity trade-offs.
Hyperscale, GPU cloud, or AI infrastructure background, particularly inside an organization scaling through hypergrowth.
Experience with both greenfield builds and colocation tenant deployments, including landlord interface management.
Familiarity with GPU cluster deployment: rack integration, network fabric bring-up, node burn-in, and validation testing.
Candidates based near our Las Vegas or Richmond hubs are preferred.

What we offer

Stock Options
100% paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance for Employees
Company Health Savings Account Contributions
100% paid Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance for Employees
Life and Voluntary Supplemental Insurance Options
Other Insurance Options, such as Pet & Legal Insurance
Various Supplementary Health Benefits, such as discounted Virtual Healthcare Appointments and Serious Illness Support
Flexible Spending Account
401(k)
Employee Assistance Program
Flexible PTO
Paid Holidays
Parental Leave
Other In-Office Perks

Equal Employment Opportunity

Reasonable Accommodations

TensorWave provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact accomodations@tensorwave.com.

Employment Eligibility

Data Privacy Notice

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that TensorWave may collect, use, and retain your personal information for recruiting and employment-related purposes in accordance with applicable data privacy laws.

Description

The application window will close October 31, 2026.

Job Location

The primary work location for this role is the United States with a remote work model with being based in CT, NJ, NY, or MA preferred.

About Envestnet 

Envestnet is an adaptive WealthTech company that is redefining the future of wealth management by helping advisors meet the moment with its comprehensive technology, actionable insights, and industry leading support. Backed by  
over 25 years of experience and approximately $7.0 trillion in platform assets, Envestnet is trusted by over one third of financial advisors across leading banks, wealth managers, brokerages, and RIAs.  

For a deeper look at how Envestnet is shaping the future of financial advice, visit www.envestnet.com.  

The Team You’ll Join

The Finance team at Envestnet plays a key role in driving efficiency, innovation, and execution across the organization by leading high-impact, technology-focused initiatives. Partnering closely with Finance, IT, and cross-functional stakeholders, the team delivers complex system implementations, process enhancements, and digital transformation efforts that strengthen financial operations and decision-making. By bridging business needs with technical solutions, improving workflows, and ensuring strong governance and compliance, the team helps modernize how Finance operates—creating a dynamic environment for those who enjoy collaborating across functions and driving meaningful, enterprise-wide impact.

How
 You
’ll
 Contribute

Plans, monitors and manages internal projects from initiation through completion. Leads or coordinates project planning, resourcing, and subcontract management, progress reporting, troubleshooting and people management. Ensures project results meet requirements regarding technical quality, reliability, schedule and cost. Monitors performance and recommends schedule changes, cost adjustments or resource additions.

Provides Project Management support for routine projects within a functional, operational or technical area.
Works with cross-functional project team members to define, sequence and estimate activities and duration.
Synthesizes diverse sets of information into plans and schedules.
Estimates resources, cost and other budget needs.
Supports and facilitates all phases of project execution.
Facilitates face-to-face communication and project feedback, from the initial kickoff meeting through milestone reporting and close-out.
Ensures effective cross-functional participation.
Monitors metrics and reports on progress, issues and status.
Ensures consistency and adherence to company standards, processes and policies.
Identifies and translates client needs into project timelines that effectively address potential risks.
Leads Finance technology initiatives, including financial system implementations, ERP upgrades, digital transformation efforts, system integrations, and data migration projects.
Serves as the primary liaison between Finance, IT, vendors, and business stakeholders, translating business requirements into effective technology solutions and project outcomes.

Ensures Finance technology projects meet internal control, audit, compliance, and data governance requirements while maintaining appropriate project documentation and implementation oversight.

 You
’ll
 Need to Bring

Candidates should demonstrate the relevant experience, skills, and capabilities needed to successfully perform in the role. Relevant experience may be gained through current responsibilities, prior roles, project work, leadership opportunities, or other comparable experiences.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
Strong command of the Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without loss of quality.
Superior time management capabilities and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines in fast-paced environments.
Solid written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to senior executives clearly and confidently.

Nice-to-Haves

5+ years of project management experience, with 2 years managing technology-related projects preferred.

Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Envestnet

Help shape the future of WealthTech. At Envestnet you’ll gain hands-on experience and collaborate with some of the industry’s brightest minds to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions that make a real difference.

We value flexibility in how and where work gets done, and we recognize strong performance with meaningful rewards—because your contributions should drive both business success and your own personal growth. If you’re looking for a place where your work has impact, your development is supported, and your contributions are truly valued, Envestnet is where you can build your future.

The opportunity is now!  

Sponsorship

This position is not open to candidates requiring visa sponsorship

Our Investment in You

The range listed  represents  a good-faith estimate of base salary compensation for this position and does not include incentive compensation, equity or benefits. Why This Role Matters

As a mission program manager , you’ll deliver a complex Satellite Mission program end-to-end, ensuring customer success, on-time execution, and scalable delivery excellence.

You will ensure the full lifecycle of customer missions—from contract execution through delivery—acting as the central orchestrator across engineering, product, operations, and commercial teams. Your role is to ensure programs deliver against commitments while building strong, trusted customer relationships.

This role directly contributes to ICEYE’s ambition to become the leading provider of space-based ISR infrastructure by scaling reliable, high-impact mission delivery globally.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Expected outcomes

Deliver assigned Satellite Mission programs on time, within budget, and to agreed performance standards
Build and maintain trusted, long-term customer relationships, acting as the primary interface throughout program execution and supporting Customer Success Management activities
Establish and drive clear program plans (scope, milestones, resources, financials) aligned with internal and customer objectives
Identify, manage, and resolve risks, dependencies, and escalations to ensure uninterrupted program delivery
Orchestrate cross-functional execution across engineering, product, operations, and commercial teams
Support the implementation of scalable program management practices that improve delivery reliability and efficiency across Missions
Establish effective reporting structure and communication channels and mechanisms to ensure timely and accurate information flow among program team members, stakeholders, and senior leadership

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience (5–10 years) managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs involving advanced technology systems (e.g., space, defence, telecom, automotive, IT, or similar)
Strong customer-facing experience, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and navigate complex requirements
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams
Expertise in program planning, execution, and governance (scope, schedule, budget, risk management)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make decisions under uncertainty
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences

Nice To Haves

Experience working on satellite or similarly complex system programs
Experience with governmental or defense customers
Knowledge of hardware, software, or embedded systems development
Experience in product development environments
Master’s degree in business, engineering, or a relevant field
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification

Application Process

Initial screening call with Talent Attraction
Hiring Manager interview
Case Study & Interview
Final interview
References

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

The role monitors progress, manages risks and change, resolves challenges, and communicates with stakeholders to provide regular updates. The role typically manages mid-sized to large projects and is expected to independently deliver results with minimal supervision, while progressively increasing revenue responsibility.

Responsibilities

Project team leadership expectations:
Set direction: Support defining objectives, decision-making processes, schedules, budgets and success factors. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment

Job Description

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

Key Responsibilities

Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy

Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

Architecture and AI Deployment

Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.

jobs.description:
Position Purpose:
Promote increased program efficiency, service levels, and value by capturing and monitoring performance, and then identifying opportunities for improvement and strategies to realize those opportunities. Plan, organize, monitor, oversee and lead multiple, concurrent resultant projects utilizing cross functional teams to deliver defined requirements and meet company strategic objectives.

Key Details:
The Program Manager III leads the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex Mission Simplify initiatives supporting Provider Data Operations transformation. Partnering across business, technology, domain, and operational teams, this role drives initiatives from discovery through implementation and operational transition. The ideal candidate is a strategic, influential leader who aligns stakeholders, mitigates risk, and delivers measurable improvements in efficiency, provider data accuracy, and enterprise consistency through process optimization, automation, operating model transformation, and technology enablement.

Identify opportunities to increase efficiency, improve service levels, ensure regulatory compliance, and support successful implementation of Mission Simplify initiatives through enhanced operations.
Develop strategies to realize improvement opportunities and ensure organizational prioritization, resource alignment, and achievement of strategic business objectives.
Manage multiple projects through the full project lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, scope definition, project planning, resource management, budget oversight, implementation, deployment, and transition activities.
Utilize corporate and industry-standard project management tools and techniques to develop integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, and executive status reporting.
Maintain detailed project documentation, including action items, issues logs, risk mitigation plans, business requirements, acceptance criteria, and testing readiness documentation.
Provide leadership and effectively communicate project status to all stakeholders through executive summaries, dashboards, presentations, and governance updates.
Negotiate with project stakeholders to identify and secure resources, resolve issues, mitigate risks, and ensure stakeholder alignment and formal scope sign-off.
Lead cross-functional meetings and governance routines with Business Analysts, SMEs, technology teams, operational leaders, and business partners to meet stakeholder expectations and organizational objectives.
Provide functional and technical knowledge regarding overall program requirements, operational processes, and business solution implementation.
Monitor project health, track key performance indicators, identify risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans to ensure business benefits and value realization objectives are achieved.
Support change management, training readiness, stakeholder communications, and operational transition activities to promote successful adoption and implementation.
Establish and promote project management standards, tools, templates, and best practices while managing multiple concurrent initiatives with varying levels of complexity and organizational impact.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, related field, or equivalent experience.
Master’s degree preferred.
5+ years project implementation, product or program management experience.
Managed care or prescription benefit management experience preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare payer, provider operations, provider data management, network operations, or health plan experience.
Proficiency with project management and reporting tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, Power BI, Microsoft Office Suite, and collaboration platforms.
PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, Scrum, or related certification.
Experience leading process improvement, automation, digital transformation, or operating model redesign initiatives.
Knowledge of provider credentialing, provider data management, enrollment operations, network management, or healthcare operations.
Experience supporting large-scale strategic transformation programs with measurable operational and financial outcomes including presenting to senior leadership and influencing decision-making across multiple business functions.
Experience leading enterprise-wide and cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience managing project plans, requirements, risks, dependencies, budgets, and executive communications.
Experience facilitating requirements workshops, stakeholder engagement sessions, and governance reviews.
Knowledge of project management methodologies and delivery frameworks.

Pay Range: $87,700.00 - $157,800.00 per year

jobs.title: Senior Hydropower FERC Licensing Program Manager (Remote/Hybrid)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Tetra Tech is adding an accomplished, client-focused Senior Hydropower FERC Licensing Program Manager
to lead and expand our national hydropower licensing, compliance, and regulatory services practice.

This senior leadership position will direct complex Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC)
licensing, relicensing, compliance, amendment, exemption, surrender, transfer, and dam removal initiatives for hydropower and water resource clients across the United States.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in hydropower licensing and environmental compliance, extensive experience navigating complex regulatory frameworks, and a proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, regulatory agencies, Tribal Nations, stakeholders, and industry partners.

Working closely with Tetra Tech's Power & Energy and Water Initiatives leadership, regional operations, and technical practice leaders, this individual will play a key role in growing our hydropower services portfolio, strengthening strategic client relationships, identifying and pursuing new opportunities, developing capture strategies, and leading winning proposals.

This role combines exceptional project and program delivery with business development and client leadership. The successful candidate will lead and support federal, state, Tribal, and local permitting and licensing efforts for dam and hydropower projects, including regulatory strategy, agency coordination, FERC licensing support, environmental review, technical documentation, and stakeholder engagement.

This position is remote within the United States
, with travel required as necessary to support clients, projects, regulatory activities, and business development efforts.

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges.Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world.For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability.Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development.Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference.Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Essential Job Functions

Program Leadership & Strategic Direction

Serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert for hydropower licensing, compliance, and regulatory affairs.
Provide strategic leadership for Tetra Tech's hydropower licensing and compliance program, including oversight of active licenses, relicensing efforts, license amendments, transfers, surrender proceedings, and dam removal projects.
Identify and develop new business opportunities and strategic partnerships within the hydropower, renewable energy, and water resources sectors.
Lead capture planning, opportunity positioning, proposal development, interview preparation, and contract negotiations.
Develop licensing and regulatory strategies that align client objectives with federal, state, Tribal, and local regulatory requirements.
Lead multidisciplinary teams of environmental scientists, engineers, planners, cultural resource specialists, fisheries biologists, and stakeholder engagement professionals.
Provide executive-level guidance to clients regarding regulatory risk management, compliance obligations, permitting strategy, and long-term asset planning.
Serve as a senior client manager and trusted advisor to utilities, public power agencies, municipalities, irrigation districts, independent power producers, and other hydropower asset owners.
Strengthen key client relationships, position priority accounts, identify new opportunities, and support business growth across Tetra Tech's national hydropower practice.

Regulatory Strategy & Project Delivery

Lead and manage FERC licensing and compliance projects from initiation through closeout, ensuring exceptional technical quality, schedule performance, and client satisfaction.
Lead negotiations and engagement with FERC, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, National Marine Fisheries Service, Bureau of Reclamation, Tribal Nations, state resource agencies, and local governments.
Lead regulatory strategy and agency coordination for hydropower development at existing non-powered dams and federally authorized water resource projects.
Interpret and apply the Federal Power Act and coordinate FERC licensing requirements with other federal project approvals.
Advise clients on regulatory pathways associated with non-powered dam hydropower development, including USACE Section 408 permissions, federal project compatibility determinations, engineering review requirements, and stakeholder coordination.
Direct preparation of licensing applications, amendment requests, surrender applications, compliance filings, environmental reports, management plans, technical studies, and regulatory correspondence.
Guide technical study programs and environmental review efforts supporting FERC licensing and compliance activities.
Facilitate complex stakeholder discussions involving environmental, cultural, recreation, fisheries, water quality, and operational issues.
Provide expert-level interpretation of applicable federal and state regulations and agency requirements.
Manage project financial performance, staffing, scope development, subcontractor management, schedules, and project risk.
Maintain high standards for technical quality, regulatory compliance, safety, and client service.
Conduct activities in accordance with internal procedures, applicable legislation, and industry standards.
Maintain current technical and industry knowledge through continuous professional development.
Work safely at all times and report health and safety incidents and concerns in accordance with company procedures.
Perform additional duties as required.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Natural Resources, Environmental Planning, Engineering, Public Policy, Hydrology, Fisheries, Recreation Management, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible experience managing environmental permitting, regulatory compliance, hydropower licensing, or related energy infrastructure projects.
7+ years of direct FERC hydropower licensing, relicensing, compliance, amendment, exemption, transfer, or surrender experience.
Demonstrated success managing complex multidisciplinary projects and leading technical teams.
Strong understanding of the Federal Power Act and its application to hydropower licensing, exemptions, amendments, and development opportunities at existing dams and water resource infrastructure.
Proven experience serving as a primary client contact and managing key client relationships.
Strong understanding of hydropower operations, dam infrastructure, environmental compliance, and stakeholder engagement processes.
Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, contracts, schedules, staffing, and profitability.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex regulatory and technical information to clients, agencies, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated ability to develop client relationships and support business development, capture, and proposal activities.
Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and without restrictions.

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive experience with FERC's Integrated Licensing Process (ILP), Traditional Licensing Process (TLP), and Alternative Licensing Process (ALP).
Experience leading hydropower relicensing efforts from initial scoping through license issuance.
Familiarity with the hydropower industry in the Pacific Northwest.
Strong understanding of NEPA, Endangered Species Act (ESA), Clean Water Act Sections 401 and 404, Section 106 consultation, Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act, and related federal and state regulatory requirements.
Experience supporting or managing hydropower development at existing non-powered dams, including familiarity with Federal Power Act requirements, FERC licensing processes, and USACE Section 408 review and approval procedures.
Understanding of USACE civil works infrastructure, including the Section 408 permission process and associated engineering, operational, environmental, and risk-evaluation requirements for modifications to federally authorized projects.
Experience supporting dam removal, fish passage, dam rehabilitation, or water resource infrastructure projects.
Established relationships with FERC staff, federal resource agencies, state agencies, Tribal Nations, and hydropower industry stakeholders.
Established industry reputation demonstrated through conference presentations, publications, committee participation, or leadership roles in professional organizations.

Work Environment & Travel

This position may be performed remotely within the United States, based on business and project needs.
Travel will be required periodically for client meetings, project activities, agency and stakeholder meetings, conferences, business development, and coordination with Tetra Tech teams.
Work may involve collaboration with geographically dispersed project teams and clients throughout the United States.

Life At Tetra Tech

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits. https://www.tetratech.com/careers/life-at-tetra-tech/
Merit-based financial rewards.
Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

A pre-employment drug screen in compliance with federal regulations is required, along with a physical if needed.

Compensation

Pay commensurate with experience.

Pay Range: $160,000-$220,000 annually

Pay Range - There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience and demonstrated work experience in the above role; skills, certifications, and competencies that align to the specified role; geographic location; and education, as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.

At Tetra Tech, health and safety play a vital role in our success. Tetra Tech’s employees work together to comply with all applicable health & safety practices and protocols, including public health orders and regulations that are mandated by local, state, provincial, federal, international authorities, and clients.

About Tetra Tech

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science ® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

Tetra Tech is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, marital or familial status, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

We invite applications from all interested parties.

Explore our open positions at https://www.tetratech.com/careers Follow us on social media to learn more about our people, c

2026-09-16

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

This role is ideal for a seasoned leader who combines strategic program leadership with hands-on technical program management and has successfully delivered complex initiatives for global organizations.

The successful candidate will possess deep experience working with North American and other onshore business teams, leading globally distributed delivery organizations, and driving execution across Agile and Hybrid delivery models. This individual will partner closely with executive stakeholders, business leaders, product teams, architects, and engineering organizations to ensure predictable delivery of strategic business outcomes.

Enterprise Program Leadership
Lead multiple complex, cross-functional technology programs across ERP, CRM, SAP, and enterprise applications.
Develop and execute integrated program plans encompassing scope, schedule, budget, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes.
Drive enterprise-wide program governance, executive reporting, and portfolio health reviews.
Ensure delivery aligns with organizational strategy, architecture standards, and business priorities.
Technical Program Management
Possess strong technical acumen to effectively collaborate with Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, Product Owners, and Delivery Teams.
Manage end-to-end implementation activities including integrations, data migration, infrastructure readiness, testing, cutover, and deployment.
Facilitate technical decision-making while balancing business priorities and delivery risks.
ERP / SAP / CRM Delivery
Lead enterprise implementations involving SAP (ECC/S4HANA preferred), CRM platforms (Salesforce, Dynamics, SAP CRM, or similar), middleware, and enterprise integrations.
Coordinate large-scale transformation initiatives involving Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Customer Service, Sales, or Operations.
Ensure successful adoption through effective stakeholder engagement and organizational change coordination.
Portfolio & Executive Leadership
Operate as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leadership.
Present concise executive updates, recommendations, and decision papers to VP and CIO-level stakeholders.
Drive portfolio prioritization, dependency management, investment planning, and resource optimization.
Lead governance forums and steering committee meetings with executive presence and confidence.
Agile Delivery Leadership
Drive execution using Agile, Hybrid, and traditional delivery methodologies based on business needs.
Partner with Product Managers, Scrum Masters, Release Train Engineers, and Agile teams to improve delivery predictability.
Champion Agile planning, PI Planning, backlog management, dependency tracking, and continuous improvement practices.
Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and delivery excellence.
Stakeholder Management
Build trusted partnerships with business executives, product organizations, vendors, and global delivery teams.
Influence without authority across geographically distributed teams.
Manage competing priorities while maintaining strong customer focus.
Vendor & Global Delivery Management
Lead globally distributed teams across North America, India, Europe, and other regions.
Manage strategic vendor relationships, delivery performance, contracts, and service quality.
Ensure alignment between internal teams and external implementation partners.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (Master's degree or MBA preferred).
10+ years of progressive Program and Portfolio Management experience within large enterprise organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide ERP, CRM, and SAP transformation programs.
Strong experience working directly with North American (onshore) business stakeholders and executive leadership.
Proven experience managing global delivery teams across multiple geographies.
Hands-on experience managing complex technical implementation programs.

At QTS, our world-class data centers are supporting our customers’ most strategic growth initiatives, positioning us at the forefront of today’s dynamic digital transformation.

Driven by purpose and fueled by a spirit of innovation, QTS designs, builds and operates some of the world’s most advanced, forward-thinking data centers. QTS is a portfolio company of Blackstone.

jobs.title: Program Manager-Committees and Projects
jobs.description:
Introduction

The California Lawyers Association (CLA) is the Bar association for all California attorneys. We are a member-driven, mission-focused organization dedicated to the professional advancement of attorneys practicing in the state of California. CLA has eighteen Sections including the New Lawyers Section (NLS) that share an area of interest in law and each offers top-tier programs, award winning conferences, events, and provides access to outstanding legal resources. We continuously seek new ways to expand our offerings. Through premier educational, networking, and advocacy opportunities, our members can maintain expertise in their fields, build contacts, and uphold the legal profession and system. CLA also has several initiatives that support its mission of promoting excellence, diversity and inclusion in the legal profession and fairness in the administration of justice and the rule of law.

CLA is committed to promoting excellence, diversity, and inclusion in the legal profession and fairness in the administration of justice and the rule of law. We are dedicated to the professional advancement of attorneys from a variety of diverse backgrounds practicing in the state of California. All CLA employees must demonstrate cultural fluency by proactively managing bias and maintaining sensitivity to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, physical or mental disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, and age of our members and the legal community.

Summary

Under general direction of the Chief Governmental Affairs Officer , the Program Manager-Committees and Projects (PM) exercises discretion and independent judgment to provide a broad range of administrative, technical and managerial services to assist the organization in accomplishing its strategic goals.

The PM works independently to manage the business of and primarily provide support to the CLA Committees including Committee meetings, programs, special projects, and other duties as assigned. Secondarily, the PM also may be asked to provide support to the California Lawyers Foundation (CLF). The PM acts as a strategic advisor to committee leaders, offering input and direction to ensure alignment with CLA’s mission and long-term goals. Serving as the operational hub for CLA’s committees, the PM ensures cross-departmental communication and maintains the continuity of programs as leadership transitions occur annually. This position is key to advancing CLA’s mission through thought leadership, operational excellence, and high-level program management. This position requires overnight, out of town travel within California.

The PM performs a wide range of functions both independently and collaboratively. In addition to these responsibilities, the PM takes on numerous managerial and supervisory duties. This includes providing high-level administrative support to the senior leadership team, preparing reports and financial data, and effectively interacting with all levels of internal management, staff, clients, and vendors.

Duties And Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic advisor to committee leaders, providing high-level guidance to ensure committee initiatives align with the organizational strategy and goals
Execute all logistics and operations for Committee activities and programs, including preparing and presenting agendas, minutes, project status reports, and administrative reports for Committees
Research, analyze, create and update materials and resources to support initiative projects including project plans, toolkits, rosters, spreadsheets, web pages, PowerPoint decks, reports, brochures, program summaries, meeting summaries and other needed resources and materials
Facilitate cross-functional collaboration, ensuring efficient communication between committees, CLA’s Staff including Marketing, the Web Team and Member Services to optimize committee output
Oversee the committee appointment process, including managing applications, tracking and organizing applicants, coordinating review sessions with committees, and communicating decisions to applicants to ensure a smooth and efficient selection process.
Manage all aspects of special projects, initiatives, campaigns, challenges, competitions, and in-person events, from concept development through execution, ensuring alignment with organizational and committee goals
Collaborate with the CLA President on the ABA House of Delegates appointments process, including updating appointment application, website updates, managing nominations, roster updates and coordinating with candidates
Serve as an organization ambassador to the Committees, ensure relevant information is fully, accurately and timely communicated to member leaders
Ensure that others on the professional team are aware of Committee decisions, events and activities that may impact them and ensure that the Committee is aware of decisions, event or activities happening in other parts of CLA
Promote CLA activities to entice new membership and increase attendance
Negotiate with outside vendors for a variety of services
Manage and ensure compliance with CLA operational policies and procedures
Respond promptly (within 24 hours) to member leaders’ questions, problem-solve issues that may arise and follow questions or issues through to resolution
Establish and maintain high-level relationships with external stakeholders, driving partnerships that enhance CLA’s educational and professional development offerings
Represent CLA at programs and other functions, coordinate Committee activities with other CLA staff and outside agencies
Coordinate the development of publicity, materials, speakers, registration and programs for CLA MCLE programs
Assume primary responsibility in the management and operation of budgetary, administrative procedures and coordination and maintenance of the Office, department, or unit workflow requirements
Prepare, recommend and manage the departmental budget, including but not limited to monthly and yearly financial analysis of cost center(s), payment of invoices, monitoring expenditures and revenue accounts

About Us

We partner with hyperscale, enterprise, and colo clients to deliver multi-MW campuses and edge sites with speed, precision, and uncompromising safety and quality.

Position Overview

-Lead multiple concurrent or program-scale data center projects (1–20+ MW) from concept through commissioning and turnover.
-Serve as the executive interface to the client, steering strategy, risk, commercial outcomes, and cross-project standardization.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Governance

-Set program strategy and project governance; align scope, budget, schedule, and Tier resiliency goals across stakeholders.
-Build and mentor PM teams; coordinate tightly with Superintendents for constructability, sequencing, and turnover milestones.
-Provide executive reporting on KPI dashboards: cost, schedule, risk, quality, punch/defect burn-down, commissioning progress, and readiness for IT load.
Commercial & Financial Management

-Oversee cost planning, GMP development, cashflow, buyout strategy, and contingency management.
-Drive value engineering without compromising availability.
-Manage enterprise-level cost controls and commercial outcomes across multiple projects.
Commissioning & Technical Execution

-Direct commissioning strategy including test scripts, sequence of operations, load bank plans, and IST readiness.

-Verify BMS/EPMS integration and alarming.
Procurement & Logistics

-Coordinate logistics for phased energization and critical equipment delivery.
Safety & Operational Readiness

-Review MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs for hot work, lockout/tagout, and live cutovers in active -facilities.

-Mastery of P6/MS Project, Procore, and enterprise cost control.

-Familiar with Uptime Institute Tier methodology, ANSI/TIA-942 ratings, and ASHRAE TC 9.9 thermal guidance.

What We Offer

-Executive-level impact on global infrastructure
-Competitive compensation with performance bonus
-Comprehensive benefits package
-Accelerated career growth in the mission-critical market
-Opportunity to lead complex, high-profile data center programs worldwide

jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Media
is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month.

AdsWizz
, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, Ad Technology, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership.
Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.
Advocate for program(s) health and long-term strategy.

Organizational Effectiveness & Governance

Define and institutionalize Ads TPM org-wide program governance standards, operating models, and best practices, elevating execution rigor across the entire Ads Engineering organization.
Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.
Continuously improve governance and delivery processes to increase predictability, execution quality, and program health over time.
Establish and facilitate team-level ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and/or other meetings needed to ensure smooth execution and team alignment.
Partner with TPM leadership to run program level ceremonies like intake and refinement if required.
Define, instrument, and socialize delivery and operational health metrics (e.g., predictability, cycle time, throughput, readiness, and post-launch outcomes) to drive transparent decision-making and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication

Build formal cross-functional networks across Product, Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and partner programs to drive alignment and coordinated execution; influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leadership.
Serve as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, and external stakeholders.
Present clear, scenario-based decision paths to engineering and business leadership, driving consensus through clarity.
Resolve conflict and maintain alignment across directors, tech leads, and cross-functional partners with authority and credibility.

What You’ll Need

Requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience, leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
Demonstrated experience owning Enterprise program strategy — including multi-year roadmap partnership, portfolio-level decision support, and org-wide process improvement — not just execution.
Significant experience in advertising technology, including ad-serving systems, real-time bidding, monetization platforms, data pipelines, and analytics systems.
Proficient architectural literacy across multiple platform programs; ability to guide teams toward scalable solutions and evaluate cross-program constraints and tradeoffs.
Executive-level communication skills; ability to craft scenario-based decision paths for senior engineering and business leadership and drive consensus through clarity.
Proven ability to drive delivery across tightly coupled, interdependent systems at scale.
Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal oversight across ambiguous, high-stakes programs.
Experience working across multiple Agile methodologies; proficiency with Jira and related program management tooling.
Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as chatGPT, Gemini, etc.
Strong propensity toward relationship building and influencing without authority.
Experience in digital audio or media platforms preferred.
Experience managing vendor or third-party technology integrations, including global or multi-region platforms preferred.
Experience in high-availability, real-time systems environments preferred.
Experience leading platform transformation or cross-organizational consolidation programs preferred.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $150,100 to $179,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

The requirements and duties described above may be modified or waived by the Company in its sole discretion without notice.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager - Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Job Details

About IonQ

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world's leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ's newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location:
This role will work onsite at our office located in Bothell, WA.

Travel:
As needed.

Job ID:
1859

The Role

Compute Platform turns quantum capability into quantum utility by building the APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, and application layer that connect IonQ's QPUs to users. Without it, powerful hardware goes nowhere.

We're hiring a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to lead cross-functional programs across the application platform, developer tooling, and compiler stack. You'll report directly to the VP of the department and carry program-level decision-making authority, with the ownership that comes with it.

You'll work across four engineering teams and roughly forty engineers, supporting multiple concurrent programs. You'll operate in high ambiguity: the problems here don't have established playbooks, because turning quantum computers into commercial products is a problem nobody has finished solving. If that sounds like the interesting part, we should talk.

This is a high-visibility role with ownership of some of the company's highest-priority initiatives. As such, this role will routinely interact with senior technical leadership and key partners.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end delivery of IonQ's application platform, developer tools, and compiler roadmap, spanning numerous cross-functional development threads
Partner with engineering leadership to turn technical vision into incremental milestones that ship, identifying risks and mitigations before they become schedule problems
Build and run the timelines, tracking, and reporting that teams actually use, where the measure of success is adoption; you'll have access to cutting edge AI tools as a force multiplier
Keep the systems of record honest. Our plans live across PRDs, trackers, and Jira, and when those drift apart the program is flying blind. You'll close that gap and automate the checking
Make invisible work visible: on-call burden, sustaining load, and technical debt tracked as rigorously as feature delivery
Dive into the details on long-pole problems. When a program stalls, you're in the weeds with the team
Surface unresolved risks early, before you have a full solution or complete stakeholder alignment. We'd rather hear it messy and on time
Manage dependencies across internal and external teams, technical and non-technical
Write and present concise, data-driven status to senior leadership
When engineers have great ideas off-roadmap, help turn them into formal proposals for potential prioritization

Requirements

8+ years managing technical programs and delivering against aggressive timelines
Track record leading technical teams through genuine ambiguity, not just executing a defined plan
Experience in developer tools, SDKs, compilers, or adjacent platform software
A habit of turning diffuse problems into specific, minimal, assignable asks
Technical fluency to engage engineering leads directly on scoping and tradeoffs, and comfort reading and reasoning about code
Willingness to re-baseline against reality rather than defend dates that have stopped being true, and the judgment to tell a target that motivates from one that just generates fiction
You've built or automated the reconciliation between planning docs and ticket systems, and you treat drift between them as a defect
Fluency moving between fast-cycle delivery and longer-horizon program building as the situation demands
AI as a core part of how you work. You've built agent-driven workflows for program management and want to push that much further
Experience in customer-facing technical roles
Highly effective written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications

Experience standing up program tracking and reporting infrastructure from scratch. You've designed a team's operating cadence, not just scheduled it, and polled the people affected before changing it
Customer-facing technical experience
Capacity and staffing modeling from conflicting inputs, with the discipline to label an unknown as unknown
A demonstrated ability to earn technical stakeholders' trust through consistency and results
Genuine enthusiasm for reading and writing PRDs and ERDs
Working knowledge of quantum computing, though no quantum background is required. We'll teach you!

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

If this role has a commission structure, the compensation range below just reflects the base compensation range.

Wage Transparency

$1 - $1 USD

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs.
The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions. Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying "U.S. Person" (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls. Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

US Non-Technical Jobs.
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!
