We are seeking a Technical Program Manager, Principal Sr. to lead the delivery of Nordstrom’s highest-impact cybersecurity programs — initiatives that protect the company’s customers, data, and operations across every technology and business function.

This senior-most individual contributor role sits within the CISO’s organization, at the intersection of security engineering, governance risk and compliance (GRC), and enterprise technology delivery. You will drive the programs that reduce Nordstrom’s risk posture at scale — partnering with security, platform, and business teams to plan, sequence, and execute complex, cross-functional security initiatives from charter through measurable outcome.

This is not a role for managing programs at arm’s length. It is a role for someone who translates security strategy into executable delivery plans, manages risk and dependencies across a portfolio of concurrent programs, holds partners accountable to commitments, and reports progress with rigor to senior leadership. You will operate with SVP/VP-level visibility and represent program delivery excellence for Nordstrom’s cybersecurity organization.

Program Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

Define and enforce delivery standards and program management best practices across the cybersecurity organization.

Cross-Functional Delivery & Stakeholder Alignment

Drive alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities, resolving conflicts and unblocking delivery through structured negotiation and clear articulation of tradeoffs.
Serve as the primary point of coordination between the cybersecurity organization and business/technology teams impacted by security programs, ensuring changes roll out with minimal disruption.
Partner with vendors and external partners supporting security program delivery, managing scope, timeline, and contractual commitments.

Metrics, Reporting & Executive Communication

Define program-level metrics and KPIs that demonstrate risk reduction, delivery velocity, and program health across the security portfolio.
Build and maintain dashboards and status reporting that give practitioners and senior leadership real-time visibility into program progress and risk.

Use data and post-program retrospectives to continuously improve program delivery practices across the organization.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

Job Description

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

Key Responsibilities

Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy

Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

Architecture and AI Deployment

Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

Automation Program Execution

Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting

Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Qualifications

10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

Required Skills And Competencies

Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

Basic Qualifications

Master's degree, plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience. Bachelor's degree in a related specialized area or equivalent relevant experience is required, plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibilityrequirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S.citizenship is required.

Responsibilities For This Position

General Dynamics Mission Systems has an immediate opening for an Information Assurance Security Professional.This position provides an opportunity to further advance the cutting-edge technology that supports some of our nation’s core defense/intelligence services and systems. General Dynamics Mission Systems employees work closely with esteemed customers to develop solutions that allow them to carry out high-stakes national security missions.

The candidate will be designated as an Information System SecurityManager (ISSM) supporting multiple Special Access Programs administering the Information Assurance (IA) Cyber duties for government customers. Components of the IA program include Assessment and Authorization (A&A) activities (i.e., documentation preparation, system configuration/validation, certification testing), security sustainment activities (i.e., hardware change management, software change management, account management, media protection, user interface, file transfers), conducting self-inspections, audit trail review, and delivering information systems security education and awareness. The candidate must be a self-starter capable of multitasking and efficiently managing their time in a dynamic environment while requiring minimal levels of supervision. Additionally, the candidate will possess effective written, speaking, analytical, organizational, and customer service skills that will assist them in identifying solutions to complex compliance and security problems. The ISSM will coordinate duties with the System Administrators and/or Information Technology (IT) staff to ensure all configuration requirements are implemented and functional. The ISSM will conduct technical and nontechnical reviews and audits.

Imagine a world-class engineering environment. Now add a team of exceptional talent along with technologies that are so advanced they’re often classified. That’s what you’ll find at General Dynamics Mission Systems. Here you’ll lead amazing engineers as they invent the technologies, products and services that help our service members, intelligence analysts and first responders keep our nation safe. If you want the chance to lead, it’s time to bring your talent to General Dynamics Mission Systems.

We apply advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, AR/VR, Cloud Native and Quantum Physics to solve our customers’ missions in cyber, RF, undersea, interstellar and everything in between.

Providing security engineering and integration services to customers, you’ll develop and execute security controls, defenses and countermeasures to intercept and prevent internal or external attacks or attempts to infiltrate company email, data, e-commerce and web-based systems. You’ll also research attempted or successful efforts to compromise systems security and design countermeasures, maintain hardware, software and network firewalls and encryption protocols and administer security policies to control physical and virtual access to systems.

What you’ll experience:

Technologies that aren’t just top-notch, they’re often top-secret
A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered

What you bring to the table:

A Bachelor’s degree in a related specialized area or equivalent plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience
Ability to develop, test, debug and deploy code or processing routines that support security protocols for an established system or systems
Ability to apply current computer science technologies to the design, development, evaluation, and integration of computer systems and networks to maintain system security
Very strong knowledge of the following:
disaster recovery and continuity of operations plans
response and handling methodologies
resource management principles and techniques
server administration and systems engineering theories, concepts, and methods
system life cycle management principles, including software security and usability
information security program management and project management principles and techniques
network systems management principles, models, methods (e.g., end-to-end systems performance monitoring), and tools
security architecture concepts and enterprise architecture reference models
applicable business processes and operations of customer organizations
system software and organizational design standards, policies, and authorized approaches relating to system design

What sets you apart:

Creative thinking with the ability to multi-task
Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success
Commitment to ongoing professional development
Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

Target salary range: USD $132,859.00/Yr. - USD $140,000.00/Yr. This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading client technology projects from internal handoff and initiation through planning, execution, acceptance, transition, and closeout. Operating in a fast-paced Value-Added Reseller (VAR), Managed Services Provider (MSP), and IT consulting environment, this role coordinates customers, engineers, vendors, procurement, sales, and managed services to deliver defined outcomes on time, within scope, and within approved financial parameters. The ideal candidate combines disciplined project governance with practical judgment, strong customer leadership, and enough technical fluency to manage infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, network, data center, and workplace technology initiatives. This position owns the project management process and project communication; technical design and engineering decisions remain with the assigned technical resources. Success requires consistent follow-up, early escalation, accurate records, and a strong commitment to customer experience and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Project Initiation & Planning

Lead the transition of sold work from Sales and Pre-Sales/Professional Services into delivery, confirming the statement of work, assumptions, exclusions, deliverables, acceptance criteria, budget, timeline, dependencies, and customer responsibilities before execution begins
Conduct project kickoff meetings and establish clear governance, stakeholder roles, communication cadence, escalation paths, decision authority, and working agreements
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, work breakdown structures, resource forecasts, and dependency maps appropriate to project size and complexity
Confirm that engineering resources, customer contacts, procurement requirements, licensing, equipment, site readiness, access, maintenance windows, and third-party dependencies are aligned before work is scheduled
Establish and maintain the project record, including project charter or initiation documentation, stakeholder register, baseline schedule, budget, RAID log, change log, decision log, and communications plan
Scope, Financial & Change Control
Risk, Issue & Quality Management
Customer & Stakeholder Management
Resource, Capacity & Cross-Functional Coordination
Documentation, Systems & Process Improvement

Project Execution & Delivery

Manage multiple concurrent client projects across infrastructure, networking, cloud, Microsoft 365, cybersecurity, storage, virtualization, data center, endpoint, and related professional services engagements
Coordinate day-to-day execution across engineers, customers, vendors, subcontractors, procurement, account management, and managed services while maintaining clear ownership of actions and deadlines
Facilitate status meetings, working sessions, readiness reviews, cutover planning, and post-implementation reviews; distribute concise notes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates promptly
Track progress against the approved baseline, identify schedule or delivery variance, and drive corrective actions without assuming technical ownership that belongs to engineering
Ensure customer decisions, technical prerequisites, access requirements, approvals, deliverables, and acceptance evidence are secured at the appropriate stage of the project
Coordinate change windows, implementation communications, rollback planning, and business-impact awareness with technical leads and customer stakeholders

Required Experience & Education

5+ years of project management experience, including responsibility for customer-facing IT infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, network, or professional services projects; VAR, MSP, systems integrator, or IT consulting experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities, shared technical resources, external dependencies, and customer-facing deadlines
Working knowledge of predictive, agile, and hybrid project delivery approaches and the judgment to scale governance to the size, risk, and complexity of the engagement
Experience managing scope, schedules, budgets, labor forecasts, risks, issues, changes, vendors, customer communications, and formal project closeout
Information Technology, Project Management, Management Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education, certification, and relevant experience will be considered

Preferred Project Management Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strongly preferred
Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) may be considered for candidates with strong directly relevant IT project experience who are actively progressing toward PMP certification
PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PRINCE2, or comparable agile/project delivery certification is beneficial
ITIL Foundation or comparable IT service management certification is beneficial, particularly for projects transitioning into managed services

Ardham Technologies is headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, and is experiencing rapid growth throughout the Southwest and Texas regions. As an exciting and innovative technology company, Ardham Technologies is dedicated to powering clients into the future of IT through comprehensive managed services and cutting-edge technology solutions. Our mission is to transform how organizations approach their technology infrastructure by delivering innovative managed offerings that drive business success. With our expanding presence across multiple markets, we provide our team members with exceptional opportunities for professional growth while working with diverse clients across various industries. Program Manager – Simulator Deployment and Sustainment
Job Description
Position Summary
The Program Manager is the senior frontline management position responsible for leading a team of Deputy Program Managers, Product Support Specialists and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) for a multi-year program delivering training simulators to a national footprint of US Government facilities. This role focuses on the overall program health and performance ensuring the firm-fixed price program is delivered on time, within budget, and to customer satisfaction. This program carries significant contract value, hardware and software procurement, configuration-managed baselines, and milestone deadlines with direct schedule, financial, and liquidated-damages accountability.
While the Program Manager role primary focus is to lead a strategically important program, there is also emphasis on team leadership, portfolio oversight, resource allocation, and alignment with organizational objectives. The Program Manager serves as a key link between program execution and executive leadership, and as a senior point of contact for prime contractors, Government stakeholders, and end customers on a high-consequence program.
Responsibilities
Direct Program Management
• Directly manage strategically important program with national multi-site rollouts under firm-fixed-price terms.
• Provide hands-on program leadership during critical phases, installations, test events, or resource constraints.
• Own scope, schedule, cost, and quality on assigned programs and manage milestone deadlines where slips carry contractual, financial, and liquidated-damages exposure.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
• Serves as the senior customer-facing point of contact; running program reviews, IPRs, and customer briefings
• Manage customer expectations and satisfaction through installation and site activation.
• Handle change requests, exceptions, and scope conversations with the prime and the Government.
• Build long-term customer relationships that position follow-on work and option-year exercise.
• Align project/program priorities with organizational strategy and objectives.
• Communicate program status, risks, and strategic issues to executive leadership.
• Serve as an escalation point for critical customer issues and program decisions.
• Interface with prime contractors and Government stakeholders, managing flow-down obligations, submittals, approvals, and deliverable commitments.
Program Oversight & Project Health
• Monitor the health, status, and performance within the program, including multi-site national deployments and long-duration programs with option years.
• Review project schedules, budgets, and risk profiles to identify issues requiring intervention.
• Ensure consistent application of project management, systems engineering, test and evaluation, and configuration management (CCB-governed baseline) methodologies and standards.
Cost, Schedule & Procurement Management
• Oversee cost and schedule baselines, applying earned value and other performance measures to keep firm-fixed-price program within budget.
• Guide management of Other Direct Costs, including procurement, vendor coordination, and supply-chain risk.
• Ensure integrated master schedule is maintained and that critical-path risks to installation, testing, and site activation are identified and mitigated early.
• Oversee contract deliverables required for the prime contractor to meet its obligations to the customer.
Resource & Capacity Management
• Allocate project management resources based on project priorities to identify capacity constraints.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams (development, systems engineering, test and evaluation, installation, and operations and maintenance) to ensure adequate staffing and support for project delivery.
Team Leadership & Development
• Directly manage and supervise Deputy Program Managers, Product Support Specialists and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and career development discussions with direct reports.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and guidance on project management best practices.
• Identify training needs and support professional development of team members.
• Foster a collaborative team environment and promote knowledge sharing across the organization.
• Participate in hiring, onboarding, and resource planning.
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Aviation, Business, or related field.
• 15+ years of experience in program or project management, including large-scale, multi-site technical systems.
• 5+ years of experience in a management or team leadership capacity, leading project managers or technical leads.
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
• Demonstrated experience delivering firm-fixed-price programs of significant value (multi-million dollar) with multi-year periods of performance and option years.
• Experience as a subcontractor program manager interfacing with a prime contractor and a Government end customer, including managing flow-down requirements and deliverables.
• Strong understanding of systems engineering, test and evaluation, and configuration management / controlled baselines (CCB) processes.
• Experience with cost and schedule control, including integrated master scheduling.
• Experience managing milestone-driven contracts, including risk and issue management under schedule, financial, and liquidated-damages accountability.
• Experience with project management and work management tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA), and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio).
• Strong leadership, coaching, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.
• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Position of Public Trust Clearance.
• Must be able to comply with U.S. trade and export-control requirements (ITAR, EAR, OFAC, FTR).
• Must be a U.S. citizen.
Preferred Qualifications
• MBA or Master’s degree in engineering, management, or a related field.
• Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification.
• Agile or Scrum certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe).
• Direct experience on U.S. Government programs, including FAA or National Airspace System (NAS) programs.
Working knowledge of ATC concepts, airfield/tower operations, and simulation/training environments.
• Aviation certifications or background (e.g., FAA Control Tower Operator, Pilot License, or equivalent controller/aviation experience).
• Experience managing hardware/software procurement and supply-chain logistics on large-value programs.
• Active or recently held Public Trust or higher clearance.
Travel Requirements
Domestic and international travel may be required, including travel to customer and installation sites across a national footprint to support deployments, test events, site activations, and program reviews.

The KACE Way is our commitment to our employees, to our customers, and to our communities. Join KACE and make a difference!

Job Summary

The Intelligence Analyst supports the United States Postal Inspection Service’s criminal programs involving mail fraud, financial crimes, money laundering and organized criminal enterprises. The position will be co-located with the Homeland Security Taskforce (HSTF) assisting the Mail Fraud Program involving fraud initiatives, complaints, and other HSTF Analysts by providing analysis, assessments, and investigation deconfliction services as part of an interagency team. General knowledge of federal statutes and the federal rules of criminal and civil procedure.
Demonstrated experience developing and supporting complex fraud and financial criminal cases for prosecution.
Proficient in conducting research using the internet and other commercial/public/proprietary databases
Substantial experience in analyzing data and interpreting patterns or trends using the appropriate analytical techniques and methods.
Ability to communicate orally and in writing to clearly explain analytical steps taken, additional investigative actions needed, and summarizing results of research and analysis using multiple mediums such as charts and reports.

Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks with competing priorities and meet deliverables.
Proficiency using Microsoft Office products (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint), sufficient to compile data, prepare correspondence and presentations.

Reviews and triages fraud complaints in various databases.
Analyzes complaint data and trends for further analysis and/or dissemination to the appropriate areas.
Performs liaison activities with other law enforcement agencies to identify targets, deconflict investigative activities, and provide collaboration across agencies.
Analyze data to identify and interpret patterns and trends, assess data quality, and eliminate irrelevant data.
Evaluates information from a variety of sources to determine criminal activity, conducts analysis, and presents findings.
Identifies illicit activities of bad actors and performs linkage analysis utilizing task force collaboration to determine of the organization’s network based on heuristic models and other datasets.
Evaluates and combine tools such as enhanced open source, commercial data, and government data sources to assist in development of lead-based information and identification of assets involving money laundering activities.
Analyze, develop, and disseminate intelligence such as threat reports, lead, subject and target packages to benefit operators and investigators.
Communicate analytical findings, trends, and other issues affecting the Inspection Service (IS) to the appropriate IS Program Managers. This may be in the form of formal/standardized reports, in person briefings, regularly scheduled meetings, and/or ad hoc request for information.

Brand building drives business growth by strengthening relationships with consumers, building desire over time. The Brand Health Tracking Service Line at Ipsos helps clients understand how people feel about their brands, tracks changes in performance over time, and provides insight into how advertising may be influencing consumer attitudes towards clients’ brands.

What makes this role important at Ipsos?

As part of the Brand Health Tracking team, you'll help some of Canada's leading organizations understand what drives brand performance and business growth. Working across categories including financial services, retail, telecommunications, technology, travel, QSR, CPG, and healthcare, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of business challenges, consumer behaviours, and growth opportunities.

You'll work day-to-day with data to uncover meaningful insights, collaborate across teams to solve client challenges, and develop the skills needed to become a trusted advisor. This role combines analytical thinking, problem solving, project management, and communication, providing a strong foundation for a career in brand strategy, insights, and advisory.

As you build your experience, your role can evolve beyond project execution. You'll have opportunities to contribute to client discussions, help synthesize and present findings, and support recommendations that influence business, brand, and marketing decisions. Over time, you'll develop the skills, confidence, and commercial perspective needed to become a trusted advisor to some of Canada's leading brands, helping turn consumer understanding into actions that drive growth.

Develop and update surveys, and maintain technical specifications in proprietary software
Liaise with internal operations teams to progress projects through their lifecycle
Perform quality checks throughout the project lifecycle
Perform data verification and prepare reports
Identify and solve project issues as they arise

Completed Bachelor’s degree
Experience in research, analytics, consulting, marketing, project management, business strategy, customer experience, communications, or related fields is an asset.
Interest in business, marketing, consumer behavior and brand strategy
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills
Strong intellectual curiosity, excellent problem solving, and an analytical mindset
Ability to simplify complex information
High attention to detail: ability to balance overall project goal with key milestones and tasks
Emerging leadership skills
Advanced proficiency with MS Office Suite; specifically, PowerPoint and Excel
Ability to juggle multiple projects and diplomatically respond to conflicting needs
Bilingual an asset but not required.

We Think You'll Be Successful If You Are

Naturally curious and eager to understand why consumers behave the way they do
Someone who asks thoughtful questions and enjoys challenging assumptions
A confident communicator
Interested in understanding how brands grow and compete
Comfortable working with both data and people
Motivated by learning and continuous development in terms of new tools, methodologies and skills

If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. We may consider a variety of backgrounds for a particular role and are also committed to considering candidates for available positions throughout our organization, not just the one you’re applying to!

In accordance with Ontario & British Columbia law, the estimated base salary range for this role is $50,000 to $55,000 CAD. Your final base salary will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors which may include but are not limited to location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education and/or certifications.  

What’s In It For You

At Ipsos you’ll experience opportunities for Career Development, an exceptional benefits package (including generous PTO, healthcare plans, wellness benefits), a flexible workplace policy, and a strong collaborative culture.

To find out more about all the great reasons to work at Ipsos, how we’re making an impact around the world, and more about our benefits and employee programs, please visit: Why Work at Ipsos | CA

Inclusive Workplace Commitment

Ipsos recognizes the necessity of building an inclusive culture that values each employee’s individuality and diverse perspectives. For more than 40 years, our mission has been to generate and analyze data about society, markets, brands, and behaviors to provide our clients with the insights that elevate their understanding of the world. This could not be fulfilled without Ipsos’ diverse employees who compile and analyze this data—they are the essence of who we are and what we do.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees, creating an environment that promotes inclusion, and enabling employees from all walks of life to flourish. Ipsos encourages our employees to act in a respectful and responsible manner, in line with code of best practices concerning diversity and inclusion, human rights, equality, and civility for every individual.

About Us

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - New Platform Validation Operations
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo Operations exists to deliver the Waymo Driver to the world. We are a global team building and scaling the world's first and leading autonomous fleet and operations platform. From component sourcing to end customer management, we enable and create value for Waymo through scaled and orchestrated deployment of the Waymo Driver. At Waymo, we are dedicated to building a culture that promotes collaboration and celebration. We value our team members' unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences and support and encourage all team members to share their ideas to help Waymo better serve the communities in which we operate.

In this hybrid role, you will report to a Head of Validation Operations

You Will

Lead NPI Platform Program Execution: Drive end-to-end program structuring for onboarding new platform variants into validation fleets, managing the critical path from arrival and upfit to testing and fleet deployment.
Executive Stakeholder Management & Influence: Serve as the primary operational partner to cross-functional leadership (Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Safety), actively aligning dependencies, pushing back when necessary, and driving high-level decisions.
Hands-on Operational Problem Solving: Bridge high-level program strategy with ground-level realities, stepping directly into depot/field operations as needed to unblock issues and validate processes.
Align Planning with Execution: Spearhead operating plans that reconcile demand forecasts with field realities, dynamically adjusting for real-time vehicle online rates, upfit throughput, and operator constraints.
Executive Reporting & Visibility: Formulate, automate, and present executive dashboards and operating metrics, effectively communicating operational readiness, program risks, and fleet bottlenecks to senior leadership.
Optimize Fleet Efficiency & Yield: Partner cross-functionally to build capacity and forecasting frameworks that maximize validation yield and streamline vendor operational workflows.

You Have

Operational & Program Leadership: 7–10+ years of experience leading complex technical programs or physical operations, with a proven ability to structure ambiguous initiatives from concept to execution.
Executive Presence & Communication: Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, communicate trade-offs clearly to executive leadership, and manage high-stakes cross-functional relationships.
Hands-on / "Scrappy" Mindset: Willingness to engage directly with ground-level depot workflows and physical hardware when technical roadblocks require operational triage.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Proven track record aligning cross-functional teams (Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Safety, Legal) across shifting timelines and competing priorities.

We Prefer

Hardware / NPI Testing Experience: Direct experience launching or validating automotive, autonomous vehicle, or robotics hardware platforms.
Vendor & Field Operations: Experience managing third-party vendor operations, staffing models, or depot operations.

Travel Requirements

15–30% Domestic/International Travel: Required in addition to regular local depot and site visits.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$190,000—$234,000 USD

About PROENERGY

PROENERGY is an engineering, R&D, and manufacturing powerhouse. The company addresses every need for fast-start power generation: turbine and package manufacturing, turnkey project execution, power purchase agreements, and asset lifecycle care for turbines and plants. Where others see impossible energy challenges, PROENERGY provides innovative aeroderivative solutions.

Our Footprint

PROENERGY delivers fast-start, dispatchable power solutions from worldwide centers for aeroderivative excellence. We are investing more than $1 billion through 2028 in infrastructure to serve our customers.

In Sedalia, Missouri,
our 600,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Manufacturing—a world-class investment in fast-start power and the only campus of its kind in the world—is growing by 40 percent.

In Houston, Texas,
our 500,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Lifecycle Care features a Level-IV depot and aero repair facility, which executes comprehensive services for aeroderivative engines under one roof.

In Kansas City
, we have an office with an Engineering team that supports our sought-after solutions for turnkey projects and contracted power.

And our worldwide service centers
ensure local service expertise near our customers. Our expanding service footprint includes Phoenix, Buenos Aires, New Brunswick, and additional locations in Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia.

Our Philosophy

We take care of our people and strive to make a positive difference for the world. We offer competitive pay, excellent benefits that include Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life/Disability Insurance at minimal cost to the employee, 10 paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401K plan. If you are looking for a rewarding career and possess specialized knowledge and quality-oriented problem-solving skills, we encourage you to apply today.

Position Summary

WattBridge, the world’s preeminent LM6000 delivery platform, is seeking a Development Project Manager to support all development efforts for our full power delivery platform focused on Data Center Campus style development. WattBridge developed, financed, built, owned and operated the world’s largest LM6000 portfolio consisting of 2400 MW’s from 2019 thru 2026. The platform raised over $2BN in capital and is now partnered with Energy Capital Partners as our majority sponsor. With competitive advantages in secured power equipment as an OEM, a proven track record in building out a 2400 MW portfolio, and a fully vertically integrated execution platform, we are well positioned to be highly successful in the data center industry.

The Development Project Manager responsibilities will provide primary support and leadership to the WattBridge objective of providing power generation and data center campuses that consists of 1.5 GW’s commissioned by 2029 as part of a to be developed 5 GW portfolio. These responsibilities include identification of potential campus sites, management of related project activities and routine interaction with key stakeholders inside and outside of the organization. The candidate must have the ability to work in a team setting and handle multiple priorities and requests in a professional, courteous, and confidential manner. This position will be responsible for all day-to-day project ownership responsibilities, including PO/PR, budget and forecasting development and budget variance analysis

The candidate will bring a positive attitude and will be highly motivated with strong organizational, interpersonal and communication skills.

Coordinate key stakeholder meetings and manage all communications, transcript, action lists with roles and responsibilities

Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Media
is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month.

AdsWizz
, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, Ad Technology, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership.
Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.
Advocate for program(s) health and long-term strategy.

Organizational Effectiveness & Governance

Define and institutionalize Ads TPM org-wide program governance standards, operating models, and best practices, elevating execution rigor across the entire Ads Engineering organization.
Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.
Continuously improve governance and delivery processes to increase predictability, execution quality, and program health over time.

Position Overview Hive Group, a HUBZone-certified SDVOSB and multiple award-winning organization, delivers innovative solutions to address complex, mission-critical program challenges for the federal government. We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Program Manager / Senior Financial Analyst to serve as designated Key Personnel supporting the TSA Law Enforcement Officer Reimbursement Program (LEORP) . In this dual-function role, the candidate will act as the primary contractor interface with the COR and Government task leads. 
This position is contingent upon contract award.
The primary mission is to oversee program operations, lead team workload execution, and manage financial and reimbursement operations for over 200 airport law enforcement partner agencies nationwide.
Location : This position requires personnel to be at the government site located at 6595 Springfield Center Drive, Springfield, VA 22150 and/or at Hive Group Headquarters located at 1785 Greensboro Station Pl. Suite 700 McLean VA 22102. 
Key Responsibilities & Duties Program Management & Client Interface (Key Personnel) Serve as the primary contractor Point of Contact (POC) for the Contracting Officer Representative (COR), Contracting Officer (CO), and Government Task Leads.
Provide day-to-day management, assignment of tasks, workload prioritization, and due-date tracking for contractor team personnel.
Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of all assigned SOW requirements. 
Prepare for and participate in the Post-Award Conference (within 10 days of award) and participate in Quarterly In-Person Program Management Reviews (PMRs).
Produce and deliver the Monthly Contract Status Report (MCSR) highlighting accomplishments and risks within the first 5 business days of each month.
Promptly notify the COR of any operational issues, potential performance delays, or risks on a same-day basis.

Lead Financial Specialist & Reimbursement Operations Manage budget planning, presentation, tracking, analysis, and execution support for LEORP.
Oversee and conduct the intake, tracking, verification, review, and analytical processing of monthly reimbursement invoices from over 200 airport law enforcement partner agencies.
Monitor funding availability, obligation balances, burn rates, projected reimbursement needs, and closeout actions across assigned program lines.
Perform monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial activities, including invoice aging reviews, accruals, obligation reviews, payment coordination, and financial reconciliations.
Review invoice data for complete compliance against approved agreements, funding parameters, rates, dates of service, and guidelines; flag and resolve discrepancies or calculation errors.
Ensure strict financial data integrity, standardized recordkeeping, appropriations controls, and audit readiness across program databases and financial tracking tools.
Prepare financial summaries, status reports, dashboards, spreadsheets, and management briefings.
Develop and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), templates, desk guides, and internal controls to optimize financial operations.

Qualifications Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree (BS/BA) from an accredited university.
Minimum: Bachelor’s degree and 12 years of total professional experience, including at least 4 years of specialized experience in federal government budget, finance, financial management, or closely related subject matter. experience in federal government budget, finance, and financial management operations.
Desired : 12 years of total experience with 8+ years of specialized federal government budget and finance experience. 
Technical Skills : Advanced proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite, with demonstrated advanced skillset in Microsoft Excel (complex formulas, financial modeling, data consolidation).
Working knowledge of federal budgeting processes, financial management rules, appropriations controls, and accounting procedures.

Core Competencies: Exceptional multi-tasking, analytical, organizational, and workload management skills.

Clearance & Security Requirements Background Check : Must be able to successfully complete and obtain a favorable TSA Enter-On-Duty (EOD) Suitability Determination and Public Trust Background Investigation prior to commencing work.
Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship (or permanent resident alien status as approved) is required for access to TSA systems, facilities, and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).
Non-Disclosure & Compliance: Must execute a DHS Form 11000-6 Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and comply with all Sensitive Security Information (SSI) handling and cybersecurity policies.

Compensation and Benefits The estimated base salary range for this position is $130,000 to $160,000 annually. This range represents Hive Group’s good faith and reasonable estimate of expected compensation at the time of this posting. Because this opportunity is tied to contingent project requirements, the final scope and budgetary parameters remain subject to change as project details clarify. Actual starting salary decisions are individualized and influenced by several factors, including but not limited to contract funding, geographic location, and a candidate's specific combination of education, training, skills, certifications, competencies, and relevant work experience.  Hive Group offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance (medical, dental, vision), life and disability insurance, retirement contributions, paid leave, federal holidays, professional development opportunities, and lifestyle benefits. A Commitment to Equal Opportunity Hive Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer dedicated to fair and unbiased employment decisions. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex (including gender and transgender status), age, religion, national origin, disability, marital status, veteran status, domestic partner or civil union status, gender identity, medical condition, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. Our hiring and promotion decisions are based exclusively on an individual’s qualifications and suitability for the role. Protecting Your Information Stay vigilant against fraudulent job offers and individuals impersonating Hive Group Talent Acquisition Specialists. Hive Group will never request payment details or money during the application process. Official communications will only come from email addresses ending in @hive-llc.com or @applytojob.com — not from free email services like Gmail or messaging platforms such as WhatsApp. If you receive suspicious messages requesting payment or personal information, please report them immediately to talentacquisition@hive-llc.com

This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us.

The Professional Services team at H1 plays a central role in creating that future. It’s our responsibility to implement and iterate on our platforms, data streams, and API’s delivering maximum value and usability for our customers. We do this leveraging a cross functional team that possesses industry, solution, and delivery expertise.

What You'll Do At H1

As a Sr. Implementation Manager, you will work directly with customers to deliver solutions that are transforming the healthcare landscape. You’ll sit at the intersection of Professional Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering, ensuring customers experience smooth, high-quality delivery while driving operational excellence across the services organization. This is a hands-on role combining project ownership, cross-functional coordination, and team advocacy, with meaningful visibility and impact.

You will:

Build and manage project plans to drive implementing and/or migrating the H1 solution(s) to our customers
Develop, iterate on or inform processes to create operational efficiencies within the services organization
Lead high visibility H1 initiated projects that impact customers and require both internal and external planning and communication
Be the point of contact for the CSM to get project updates from Product/Engineering
Manage customer deliverables against Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Partner with Customer Success to ensure high degree of customer satisfaction is achieved through delivery process
Partner with Product & Engineering to share customer feedback and help inform product initiatives
Partner with additional internal teams to collaborate and be the voice on the implementation team in cross-functional and strategic meetings

About You

You’re a confident, approachable leader who thrives in complexity and enjoys solving ambiguous problems. You balance strong project management discipline with excellent communication and relationship-building skills, and you know how to influence without authority in a fast-moving environment.

You have a natural ownership mindset and take pride in delivering results
You’re comfortable leading high-stakes, customer-facing initiatives
You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally and translating technical updates into clear, actionable insights
You’ve brought structure to ambiguity and stay calm under pressure
You’re energized by building and improving processes that scale

Requirements

5+ years of project management experience
2+ years of experience implementing SaaS or data solutions in the healthcare space
Effective communication and presentation skills, and the ability to successfully communicate with a variety of levels within an organization
Track record of success in a results-driven, fast-paced environment
Demonstrate grit, resilience and tenacity with a desire to succeed on your own terms scaling with the company as we grow

Compensation

This role pays $115,000 to $140,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units.

Anticipated role close date: 11/01/2026

H1 OFFERS

Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off
Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays
Retirement options
Health & charitable donation stipends
Impactful Business Resource Groups
Flexible work hours & the opportunity to work from anywhere
The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe

H1 is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy), age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Health & Wellbeing Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal.
That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

This is a remote position supporting a major retail client. Candidates are required to be available during Pacific Standard Time business hours and support onsite events as needed.

The Health & Wellbeing Program Manager is a client-dedicated member of the Personify Health account team, focused on designing and delivering a comprehensive strategic wellbeing plan, aimed at building a culture of health, enhancing health and wellbeing engagement, and driving health behavior change through awareness and activation. The Health & Wellbeing Program Manager works side by side with the Personify Health account leadership and the client’s HR, benefits, and/or stakeholder teams. This individual will provide advocacy for Personify Health products while embracing Personify Health’s mission and values. This position may include approximately 10-15% travel.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities/Duties

Provide direction and subject matter expertise in defining, designing, developing, communicating, and executing a comprehensive health and wellbeing strategy
Utilize project management skills to develop and execute health and wellbeing programs according to timeline and budget
Monitor, evaluate, and respond to program measurements and participant feedback, including operations and quality, to drive continuous quality improvement initiatives and goals
Serve as an integrated partner and the face of wellbeing to the client population, guiding members to appropriate resources and programs
Serve as a Personify Health platform expert, with deep knowledge in customizing the platform experience locally and delivering custom engagement initiatives; Deliver product demos as needed to drive enrollment and engagement
Engage and partner with client leadership, stakeholders and internal groups (Diversity & Inclusion, Employee Resource Groups, etc…) to build and support a culture of health
Leverage community partnerships to support client goals including initiatives related to social determinants of health, diversity and inclusion, health, and holistic wellbeing (mental, physical, social, community, financial, and safety wellbeing)
Collaborate with Personify Health and the client’s health plan and vendor partners to identify opportunities for health awareness and engagement, and to drive utilization of the client’s suite of health, benefits, and wellbeing programs
Launch and lead a Wellness Champion Network
Lead implementation of health promotion programs including health screenings, flu shots, and open enrollment events
Lead regular data assessment and reporting to internal and external stakeholders and leadership, while defining opportunities, tracking impact, and determining next best steps
Confidence in working with a potentially global population and understanding cultural nuances; adept at adapting the wellbeing program to meet diverse needs
Perform other related duties as assigned

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in health promotion or other health related field such as public health, community health, nutrition, exercise physiology, etc…
Master’s degree in Public Health or related field preferred
Public health related certification (ie: CHES, NWI, Chapman Institute) preferred
5+ years of experience in fields related to health and wellbeing
5+ years of experience in corporate environment preferred
Experience working with incentive programs; working knowledge of the Personify Health platform and systems/tools preferred
Health plan experience preferred

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to identify processes and organize resources to coordinate and execute multiple projects simultaneously
Skilled project manager with the ability to manage tasks, timelines and collaborate across departments to communicate and execute projects successfully
Strong technical acumen with the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly
Excellent time management
Strong business acumen
Ability to operate successfully in a matrixed environment including relationship management among multiple stakeholders and decision makers; ability to navigate client business needs alongside Personify Health business needs
Self-starter, entrepreneurial mindset
Outstanding written and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to create impactful and engaging content
Detail oriented with thoroughness and accuracy when accomplishing a task, while demonstrating concern for all areas involved
Outstanding ability to deliver presentations at all levels of an organization, including C-Suite leadership, and to diverse audiences and groups, via multiple modalities including virtually and in-person, when appropriate
Strong customer service orientation and relationship management
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
Naturally curious

Work Environment

At Personify Health we value and celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to change lives for the good.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities, but constitutes a general description of the scope and function of the role within the company. Activities, duties, and responsibilities are subject to change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits

The Highlights:

Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture?
Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation:
This position offers a base salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment:
Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe:
Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to talent@personifyhealth.com . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers .

new_jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

About the Role:

As a Sr Project Manager, you will be responsible for providing consulting services to an assigned market or high-profile client accounts to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives.

This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. This person must be located in California, will work remote, and travel up to 30%.

What You’ll Do:

Manage all areas of project management for multiple healthcare projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
Work directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project. This includes the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & milestones, quality control, and risk identification.
Define the project delivery resources from pre-qualified lists or through the project qualification process. Conduct complex requests for proposals, complete bid evaluations, and recommend resources to clients.
Facilitate the development of a charter and integrated timeline.
Ensure all functions remain on schedule and issues get resolved or escalated.
Facilitate regular meetings to review project status for active and pending projects.
Collaborate to develop solutions and guide the project team through implementation and completion.
Apply advanced knowledge to seek and develop new, better methods for accomplishing both individual and department objectives.
Showcase expertise in own job discipline and in-depth knowledge of other job disciplines within the organization function.
Coach others to develop in-depth knowledge and expertise in most or all areas within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Anticipates potential objections and persuades others, often at senior levels and of divergent interest, to adopt a different point of view.
Impact the achievement of customer, operational, project, or service objectives across multi-discipline teams. Work is guided by functional policies which impact the design of procedures and policies.
Contribute to new products, processes, standards, and/or operational plans in support of achieving functional goals.
Communicate difficult and complex ideas with the ability to influence.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree preferred with 8-10 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
The innovative mentality to develop methods that go beyond existing solutions.
Ability to solve unique problems using standard and innovative solutions having a broad impact on the business.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Expert organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mindset.
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Additional Information

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects:

Twitter

Instagram

LinkedIn

Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. new_jobs.description:
At E Tech Group
, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We’re one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 25 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals, Material Handling, Consumer Products and Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We are seeking a Project Manager
to lead a large project or multiple project efforts, which may include subcontractors, high dollar value material content and multiple resources within the Mission Critical Industry. Your responsibilities will include the management and coordination of the design, procurement, implementation, and commissioning phases of projects, including the commercial, financial, and technical success of projects.

You will take a leadership role in developing project proposals and vetting project cost estimates. You will develop and communicate a clear understanding of the client’s project goals and maintain the company’s alignment to these goals, enabling your team to exceed client expectations and budgeted profitability.

This is a remote positon with 30-50% travel expectations.

As a Project Manager, You Will:

Lead Proposal Development – Participate in proposal scope, schedule, and cost estimates, as well as Project Management methodology and project pricing and structure. Prepare for a successful handoff from Business Development.
Manage Client Communication – Ensure effective communication between the client, the project team, Business Development, and the management team at all phases of the project. Be effective at resolving scope, schedule and cost issues as they arise.
Project Schedule and Plan – Develop the project labor resource plan and procurement plan to meet the client’s schedule objective and project cash flow requirements.
Drive Scope – Maintain firm control of scope and compliance with specifications and contract requirements. Ensure that scope is well defined and communicated, and proactively obtain any required Change Orders, develop additional scope opportunities which may serve the client’s objective.
Maintain Cost – Develop and maintain project cost budgets and reports; manage estimated cost at completion, earned value, and contingency. Forecast monthly project costs avoiding cost overruns.
Lead the Project Team – Lead the project team in achieving the project tasks and milestones on schedule and under budget. Work closely with the Operations group to ensure that the right resources are assigned to the project at the optimal time. Communicate project progress to the team and to the client and be an effective advocate for the project team. Identify project risks in advance and mobilize the necessary resources to mitigate risks.
Present regular project activity and financial updates on projects to large audiences of customers and/or internal associates/management/Executives.
Become proficient in the extensive use of the E TECH GROUP PMO Methods, Tools and Process specific to project management standards.
Participate in the implementation of new project management tools that will be utilized across the enterprise.
Develop a strong level of understanding of E TECH GROUP’s Project Management Life (PMLC) Cycle Stages.
Ability to travel 30-50%.
Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

You Have:

BS Engineering degree or equivalent education/experience background.
At least 3 years of dedicated project management experience or 5+ years in a project engineering environment.
Proficient in the utilization of project management principles, methods, and tools.
Ability to implement Project Management Institute (PMI) based standards into the E TECH GROUP culture, and serve as a mentor to other associates.
Proven project leadership on difficult projects, applications, solutions, and situations.
Proven performance in a stressful environment.
Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills.
The ability to utilize technology to lead geographically dispersed project teams.
Experience managing contracts and/or subcontractors.
Experienced in the use of project management software such as MS Project.
Familiarity with industrial controls projects.
Experience with project budget / fiscal accountability.
A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

You May Have:

Controls Engineering background.
Experience with true design projects (EOR).
PMP Certified preferred
Experience with Procore, CXAlloy, and Smartsheet

Benefits & Perks:

401k + match + prompt enrollment.  E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
