Description

The application window will close October 31, 2026.

Job Location

The primary work location for this role is the United States with a remote work model with being based in CT, NJ, NY, or MA preferred.

About Envestnet 

Envestnet is an adaptive WealthTech company that is redefining the future of wealth management by helping advisors meet the moment with its comprehensive technology, actionable insights, and industry leading support. Backed by  
over 25 years of experience and approximately $7.0 trillion in platform assets, Envestnet is trusted by over one third of financial advisors across leading banks, wealth managers, brokerages, and RIAs.  

For a deeper look at how Envestnet is shaping the future of financial advice, visit www.envestnet.com.  

The Team You’ll Join

The Finance team at Envestnet plays a key role in driving efficiency, innovation, and execution across the organization by leading high-impact, technology-focused initiatives. Partnering closely with Finance, IT, and cross-functional stakeholders, the team delivers complex system implementations, process enhancements, and digital transformation efforts that strengthen financial operations and decision-making. By bridging business needs with technical solutions, improving workflows, and ensuring strong governance and compliance, the team helps modernize how Finance operates—creating a dynamic environment for those who enjoy collaborating across functions and driving meaningful, enterprise-wide impact.

How
 You
’ll
 Contribute

Plans, monitors and manages internal projects from initiation through completion. Leads or coordinates project planning, resourcing, and subcontract management, progress reporting, troubleshooting and people management. Ensures project results meet requirements regarding technical quality, reliability, schedule and cost. Monitors performance and recommends schedule changes, cost adjustments or resource additions.

Provides Project Management support for routine projects within a functional, operational or technical area.

As a mission program manager , you’ll deliver a complex Satellite Mission program end-to-end, ensuring customer success, on-time execution, and scalable delivery excellence.

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

What We’re Looking For

Experience with governmental or defense customers

Experience in product development environments

The Sr. Project Management role works to plan, execute, and oversee projects to completed on time, within budget, while meeting quality standards and health and safety requirements. The role works closely with cross-functional teams to define project scope, set objectives, allocate resources, and develop detailed project plans. The role monitors progress, manages risks and change, resolves challenges, and communicates with stakeholders to provide regular updates. The role typically manages mid-sized to large projects and is expected to independently deliver results with minimal supervision, while progressively increasing revenue responsibility.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include the following for delivering day-to-day operations for larger complex projects:

Project team leadership expectations:
Set direction: Support defining objectives, decision-making processes, schedules, budgets and success factors. Assist team by providing clarity on what the objectives are for an assignment, how decisions will be made, development of schedules and budgets, and what critical success factors the client is trying to achieve.
Communicate: Help establish effective communication methods for team standups, technical/design decisions, and client interactions.
Support Team Motivation: Assist in empowering team members, resolving conflicts, providing feedback and celebrating success.
Establish Trust: Demonstrate integrity, competence, consistency, loyalty, and transparency
Create a safe environment: Support and assist in providing an atmosphere where ideas and creativity thrive.
Embrace thought and experience diversity: Support an environment where diverse backgrounds, geographies, and different perspectives are all heard, respected and considered.
Develop team members: Support team development by contributing to continuous learning, skills development and mentoring.
Execution of BC’s project delivery requirements:
Scope: Collaborate and prepare detailed scopes of work to set clear expectations and prevent project overruns. Develop clear assumptions and limitations and set realistic expectations and a solid pathway to delivering quality work successfully.
Schedule: Collaborate on the development and maintenance of project schedules to provide for timely resource allocation and delivery. Recommend and assist implementation of schedule delay mitigation measures as needed.
Budget: Develop and collaborate on work breakdown structures and project budgets aligned with scope and schedule. to set a project up for financial success of the project. Manage budget on project to meet financial plan.
Quality Management: Create, implement and monitor quality management plans and processes to enhance client trust, minimize deficiencies, incorporate our standards and quality review processes and collaborate with team members to contribute to quality.
Change Management: Identify and manage internal and external changes to mitigate risks. Identify and recommend change management, in collaboration with project team, prepare the scope and budget for the change, and gain client endorsement and approval for the change to minimize financial and execution risk to BC.
Risk Management: Ability to identify risks, develop risk mitigation strategies and perform ongoing risk monitoring and mitigation throughout the project lifecycle. Identify and escalate risks, collaborate with teams to prepare mitigation strategies for each risk, monetization of each risk, and update the risk profile on the project throughout the lifecycle of a project.
Health & Safety: Lead by example and follow BC policy and client requirements for health and safety. Lead development and implementation of health and safety plans per the project specific requirements.
Manage external resources: including third parties/vendors to deliver successfully on their contracted scope, quality and budget
Delivery of Project and Business Performance Metrics: Lead achievement of project goals related to scope, schedule, budget and quality. Monitor profitability through routine earned value analysis and compliance, business revenue forecasting and timely invoicing/collections.
Client Service and Sales/Marketing Support and Engagement: Ability to build successful relationships with Clients, while collaborating with client service managers and project teams to assess client satisfaction. Monitor and share clients’ critical success factors for project success and client satisfaction.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

Key Responsibilities

Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy

Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

Architecture and AI Deployment

Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

Automation Program Execution

Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting

Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Qualifications

10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

Required Skills And Competencies

Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least September 22, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $179,931.00 - $315,300.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

new_jobs.title: Program Manager III - Provider Data Operations
new_jobs.description:
Position Purpose:
Promote increased program efficiency, service levels, and value by capturing and monitoring performance, and then identifying opportunities for improvement and strategies to realize those opportunities. Plan, organize, monitor, oversee and lead multiple, concurrent resultant projects utilizing cross functional teams to deliver defined requirements and meet company strategic objectives.

Key Details:
The Program Manager III leads the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex Mission Simplify initiatives supporting Provider Data Operations transformation. Partnering across business, technology, domain, and operational teams, this role drives initiatives from discovery through implementation and operational transition. The ideal candidate is a strategic, influential leader who aligns stakeholders, mitigates risk, and delivers measurable improvements in efficiency, provider data accuracy, and enterprise consistency through process optimization, automation, operating model transformation, and technology enablement.

Identify opportunities to increase efficiency, improve service levels, ensure regulatory compliance, and support successful implementation of Mission Simplify initiatives through enhanced operations.
Develop strategies to realize improvement opportunities and ensure organizational prioritization, resource alignment, and achievement of strategic business objectives.
Manage multiple projects through the full project lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, scope definition, project planning, resource management, budget oversight, implementation, deployment, and transition activities.
Utilize corporate and industry-standard project management tools and techniques to develop integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, and executive status reporting.
Maintain detailed project documentation, including action items, issues logs, risk mitigation plans, business requirements, acceptance criteria, and testing readiness documentation.
Provide leadership and effectively communicate project status to all stakeholders through executive summaries, dashboards, presentations, and governance updates.
Negotiate with project stakeholders to identify and secure resources, resolve issues, mitigate risks, and ensure stakeholder alignment and formal scope sign-off.
Lead cross-functional meetings and governance routines with Business Analysts, SMEs, technology teams, operational leaders, and business partners to meet stakeholder expectations and organizational objectives.
Provide functional and technical knowledge regarding overall program requirements, operational processes, and business solution implementation.
Monitor project health, track key performance indicators, identify risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans to ensure business benefits and value realization objectives are achieved.
Support change management, training readiness, stakeholder communications, and operational transition activities to promote successful adoption and implementation.
Establish and promote project management standards, tools, templates, and best practices while managing multiple concurrent initiatives with varying levels of complexity and organizational impact.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, related field, or equivalent experience.
Master’s degree preferred.
5+ years project implementation, product or program management experience.
Managed care or prescription benefit management experience preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare payer, provider operations, provider data management, network operations, or health plan experience.
Proficiency with project management and reporting tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, Power BI, Microsoft Office Suite, and collaboration platforms.
PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, Scrum, or related certification.
Experience leading process improvement, automation, digital transformation, or operating model redesign initiatives.
Knowledge of provider credentialing, provider data management, enrollment operations, network management, or healthcare operations.
Experience supporting large-scale strategic transformation programs with measurable operational and financial outcomes including presenting to senior leadership and influencing decision-making across multiple business functions.
Experience leading enterprise-wide and cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience managing project plans, requirements, risks, dependencies, budgets, and executive communications.
Experience facilitating requirements workshops, stakeholder engagement sessions, and governance reviews.
Knowledge of project management methodologies and delivery frameworks.

Pay Range: $87,700.00 - $157,800.00 per year

new_jobs.title: Senior Hydropower FERC Licensing Program Manager (Remote/Hybrid)
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Tetra Tech is adding an accomplished, client-focused Senior Hydropower FERC Licensing Program Manager
to lead and expand our national hydropower licensing, compliance, and regulatory services practice.

This senior leadership position will direct complex Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC)
licensing, relicensing, compliance, amendment, exemption, surrender, transfer, and dam removal initiatives for hydropower and water resource clients across the United States.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in hydropower licensing and environmental compliance, extensive experience navigating complex regulatory frameworks, and a proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, regulatory agencies, Tribal Nations, stakeholders, and industry partners.

Working closely with Tetra Tech's Power & Energy and Water Initiatives leadership, regional operations, and technical practice leaders, this individual will play a key role in growing our hydropower services portfolio, strengthening strategic client relationships, identifying and pursuing new opportunities, developing capture strategies, and leading winning proposals.

This role combines exceptional project and program delivery with business development and client leadership. The successful candidate will lead and support federal, state, Tribal, and local permitting and licensing efforts for dam and hydropower projects, including regulatory strategy, agency coordination, FERC licensing support, environmental review, technical documentation, and stakeholder engagement.

This position is remote within the United States
, with travel required as necessary to support clients, projects, regulatory activities, and business development efforts.

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges.Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world.For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability.Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development.Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference.Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Essential Job Functions

Program Leadership & Strategic Direction

Serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert for hydropower licensing, compliance, and regulatory affairs.
Provide strategic leadership for Tetra Tech's hydropower licensing and compliance program, including oversight of active licenses, relicensing efforts, license amendments, transfers, surrender proceedings, and dam removal projects.
Identify and develop new business opportunities and strategic partnerships within the hydropower, renewable energy, and water resources sectors.
Lead capture planning, opportunity positioning, proposal development, interview preparation, and contract negotiations.
Develop licensing and regulatory strategies that align client objectives with federal, state, Tribal, and local regulatory requirements.
Lead multidisciplinary teams of environmental scientists, engineers, planners, cultural resource specialists, fisheries biologists, and stakeholder engagement professionals.
Provide executive-level guidance to clients regarding regulatory risk management, compliance obligations, permitting strategy, and long-term asset planning.
Serve as a senior client manager and trusted advisor to utilities, public power agencies, municipalities, irrigation districts, independent power producers, and other hydropower asset owners.
Strengthen key client relationships, position priority accounts, identify new opportunities, and support business growth across Tetra Tech's national hydropower practice.

Regulatory Strategy & Project Delivery

Lead and manage FERC licensing and compliance projects from initiation through closeout, ensuring exceptional technical quality, schedule performance, and client satisfaction.
Lead negotiations and engagement with FERC, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, National Marine Fisheries Service, Bureau of Reclamation, Tribal Nations, state resource agencies, and local governments.
Lead regulatory strategy and agency coordination for hydropower development at existing non-powered dams and federally authorized water resource projects.
Interpret and apply the Federal Power Act and coordinate FERC licensing requirements with other federal project approvals.
Advise clients on regulatory pathways associated with non-powered dam hydropower development, including USACE Section 408 permissions, federal project compatibility determinations, engineering review requirements, and stakeholder coordination.
Direct preparation of licensing applications, amendment requests, surrender applications, compliance filings, environmental reports, management plans, technical studies, and regulatory correspondence.
Guide technical study programs and environmental review efforts supporting FERC licensing and compliance activities.
Facilitate complex stakeholder discussions involving environmental, cultural, recreation, fisheries, water quality, and operational issues.
Provide expert-level interpretation of applicable federal and state regulations and agency requirements.
Manage project financial performance, staffing, scope development, subcontractor management, schedules, and project risk.
Maintain high standards for technical quality, regulatory compliance, safety, and client service.
Conduct activities in accordance with internal procedures, applicable legislation, and industry standards.
Maintain current technical and industry knowledge through continuous professional development.
Work safely at all times and report health and safety incidents and concerns in accordance with company procedures.
Perform additional duties as required.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Natural Resources, Environmental Planning, Engineering, Public Policy, Hydrology, Fisheries, Recreation Management, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible experience managing environmental permitting, regulatory compliance, hydropower licensing, or related energy infrastructure projects.
7+ years of direct FERC hydropower licensing, relicensing, compliance, amendment, exemption, transfer, or surrender experience.
Demonstrated success managing complex multidisciplinary projects and leading technical teams.
Strong understanding of the Federal Power Act and its application to hydropower licensing, exemptions, amendments, and development opportunities at existing dams and water resource infrastructure.
Proven experience serving as a primary client contact and managing key client relationships.
Strong understanding of hydropower operations, dam infrastructure, environmental compliance, and stakeholder engagement processes.
Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, contracts, schedules, staffing, and profitability.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex regulatory and technical information to clients, agencies, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated ability to develop client relationships and support business development, capture, and proposal activities.
Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and without restrictions.

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive experience with FERC's Integrated Licensing Process (ILP), Traditional Licensing Process (TLP), and Alternative Licensing Process (ALP).
Experience leading hydropower relicensing efforts from initial scoping through license issuance.
Familiarity with the hydropower industry in the Pacific Northwest.
Strong understanding of NEPA, Endangered Species Act (ESA), Clean Water Act Sections 401 and 404, Section 106 consultation, Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act, and related federal and state regulatory requirements.
Experience supporting or managing hydropower development at existing non-powered dams, including familiarity with Federal Power Act requirements, FERC licensing processes, and USACE Section 408 review and approval procedures.
Understanding of USACE civil works infrastructure, including the Section 408 permission process and associated engineering, operational, environmental, and risk-evaluation requirements for modifications to federally authorized projects.
Experience supporting dam removal, fish passage, dam rehabilitation, or water resource infrastructure projects.
Established relationships with FERC staff, federal resource agencies, state agencies, Tribal Nations, and hydropower industry stakeholders.
Established industry reputation demonstrated through conference presentations, publications, committee participation, or leadership roles in professional organizations.

Work Environment & Travel

This position may be performed remotely within the United States, based on business and project needs.
Travel will be required periodically for client meetings, project activities, agency and stakeholder meetings, conferences, business development, and coordination with Tetra Tech teams.
Work may involve collaboration with geographically dispersed project teams and clients throughout the United States.

Life At Tetra Tech

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits. https://www.tetratech.com/careers/life-at-tetra-tech/
Merit-based financial rewards.
Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

A pre-employment drug screen in compliance with federal regulations is required, along with a physical if needed.

Compensation

The PM acts as a strategic advisor to committee leaders, offering input and direction to ensure alignment with CLA’s mission and long-term goals. Serving as the operational hub for CLA’s committees, the PM ensures cross-departmental communication and maintains the continuity of programs as leadership transitions occur annually. This position is key to advancing CLA’s mission through thought leadership, operational excellence, and high-level program management. This position requires overnight, out of town travel within California.

The PM performs a wide range of functions both independently and collaboratively. In addition to these responsibilities, the PM takes on numerous managerial and supervisory duties. This includes providing high-level administrative support to the senior leadership team, preparing reports and financial data, and effectively interacting with all levels of internal management, staff, clients, and vendors.

Serve as a strategic advisor to committee leaders, providing high-level guidance to ensure committee initiatives align with the organizational strategy and goals

Ensure that others on the professional team are aware of Committee decisions, events and activities that may impact them and ensure that the Committee is aware of decisions, event or activities happening in other parts of CLA
Promote CLA activities to entice new membership and increase attendance
Negotiate with outside vendors for a variety of services

Respond promptly (within 24 hours) to member leaders’ questions, problem-solve issues that may arise and follow questions or issues through to resolution
Establish and maintain high-level relationships with external stakeholders, driving partnerships that enhance CLA’s educational and professional development offerings
Represent CLA at programs and other functions, coordinate Committee activities with other CLA staff and outside agencies

Prepare, recommend and manage the departmental budget, including but not limited to monthly and yearly financial analysis of cost center(s), payment of invoices, monitoring expenditures and revenue accounts
Conduct major research and analysis of data and information, reports findings and makes appropriate recommendations for solution of administrative problems
Establish and maintain relationships with outside entities and individuals regarding the operation of and/or special projects for the Office
Assist with coordinating the implementation of new programs and administrative procedures and may be responsible for their operation
Consult with Committee Chairs and staff members regarding agendas, planning logistics, programs and projects.
Support the CLA leadership team as necessary
Help support the California Lawyers Foundation as necessary
Handle organizational and administrative tasks at meetings and prepare action summaries

Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to mentor staff and lead cross-functional teams.

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. SiriusXM Media
is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month.

AdsWizz
, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, Ad Technology, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership.
Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.
Advocate for program(s) health and long-term strategy.

Organizational Effectiveness & Governance

Define and institutionalize Ads TPM org-wide program governance standards, operating models, and best practices, elevating execution rigor across the entire Ads Engineering organization.
Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.
Continuously improve governance and delivery processes to increase predictability, execution quality, and program health over time.
Establish and facilitate team-level ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and/or other meetings needed to ensure smooth execution and team alignment.
Partner with TPM leadership to run program level ceremonies like intake and refinement if required.
Define, instrument, and socialize delivery and operational health metrics (e.g., predictability, cycle time, throughput, readiness, and post-launch outcomes) to drive transparent decision-making and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication

Serve as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, and external stakeholders.
Present clear, scenario-based decision paths to engineering and business leadership, driving consensus through clarity.

What You’ll Need

Requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience, leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

Significant experience in advertising technology, including ad-serving systems, real-time bidding, monetization platforms, data pipelines, and analytics systems.
Proficient architectural literacy across multiple platform programs; ability to guide teams toward scalable solutions and evaluate cross-program constraints and tradeoffs.
Executive-level communication skills; ability to craft scenario-based decision paths for senior engineering and business leadership and drive consensus through clarity.

Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal oversight across ambiguous, high-stakes programs.
Experience working across multiple Agile methodologies; proficiency with Jira and related program management tooling.

new_jobs.description:
Job Details

About IonQ

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world's leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ's newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location:
This role will work onsite at our office located in Bothell, WA.

Travel:
As needed.

Job ID:
1859

The Role

Compute Platform turns quantum capability into quantum utility by building the APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, and application layer that connect IonQ's QPUs to users. Without it, powerful hardware goes nowhere.

We're hiring a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to lead cross-functional programs across the application platform, developer tooling, and compiler stack. You'll report directly to the VP of the department and carry program-level decision-making authority, with the ownership that comes with it.

You'll work across four engineering teams and roughly forty engineers, supporting multiple concurrent programs. You'll operate in high ambiguity: the problems here don't have established playbooks, because turning quantum computers into commercial products is a problem nobody has finished solving. If that sounds like the interesting part, we should talk.

This is a high-visibility role with ownership of some of the company's highest-priority initiatives. As such, this role will routinely interact with senior technical leadership and key partners.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end delivery of IonQ's application platform, developer tools, and compiler roadmap, spanning numerous cross-functional development threads
Partner with engineering leadership to turn technical vision into incremental milestones that ship, identifying risks and mitigations before they become schedule problems
Build and run the timelines, tracking, and reporting that teams actually use, where the measure of success is adoption; you'll have access to cutting edge AI tools as a force multiplier
Keep the systems of record honest. Our plans live across PRDs, trackers, and Jira, and when those drift apart the program is flying blind. You'll close that gap and automate the checking
Make invisible work visible: on-call burden, sustaining load, and technical debt tracked as rigorously as feature delivery
Dive into the details on long-pole problems. When a program stalls, you're in the weeds with the team
Surface unresolved risks early, before you have a full solution or complete stakeholder alignment. We'd rather hear it messy and on time
Manage dependencies across internal and external teams, technical and non-technical
Write and present concise, data-driven status to senior leadership
When engineers have great ideas off-roadmap, help turn them into formal proposals for potential prioritization

Requirements

8+ years managing technical programs and delivering against aggressive timelines
Track record leading technical teams through genuine ambiguity, not just executing a defined plan
Experience in developer tools, SDKs, compilers, or adjacent platform software
A habit of turning diffuse problems into specific, minimal, assignable asks
Technical fluency to engage engineering leads directly on scoping and tradeoffs, and comfort reading and reasoning about code
Willingness to re-baseline against reality rather than defend dates that have stopped being true, and the judgment to tell a target that motivates from one that just generates fiction
You've built or automated the reconciliation between planning docs and ticket systems, and you treat drift between them as a defect
Fluency moving between fast-cycle delivery and longer-horizon program building as the situation demands
AI as a core part of how you work. You've built agent-driven workflows for program management and want to push that much further
Experience in customer-facing technical roles
Highly effective written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications

Experience standing up program tracking and reporting infrastructure from scratch. You've designed a team's operating cadence, not just scheduled it, and polled the people affected before changing it
Customer-facing technical experience
Capacity and staffing modeling from conflicting inputs, with the discipline to label an unknown as unknown
A demonstrated ability to earn technical stakeholders' trust through consistency and results
Genuine enthusiasm for reading and writing PRDs and ERDs
Working knowledge of quantum computing, though no quantum background is required. We'll teach you!

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

If this role has a commission structure, the compensation range below just reflects the base compensation range.

Wage Transparency

$1 - $1 USD

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs.
The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions. Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying "U.S. Person" (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls. new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Ad Technology
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Media
is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month.

AdsWizz
, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, Ad Technology, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership.
Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.
Advocate for program(s) health and long-term strategy.

Organizational Effectiveness & Governance

Define and institutionalize Ads TPM org-wide program governance standards, operating models, and best practices, elevating execution rigor across the entire Ads Engineering organization.
Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.
Continuously improve governance and delivery processes to increase predictability, execution quality, and program health over time.
Establish and facilitate team-level ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and/or other meetings needed to ensure smooth execution and team alignment.
Partner with TPM leadership to run program level ceremonies like intake and refinement if required.
Define, instrument, and socialize delivery and operational health metrics (e.g., predictability, cycle time, throughput, readiness, and post-launch outcomes) to drive transparent decision-making and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication

Build formal cross-functional networks across Product, Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and partner programs to drive alignment and coordinated execution; influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leadership.
Serve as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, and external stakeholders.
Present clear, scenario-based decision paths to engineering and business leadership, driving consensus through clarity.
Resolve conflict and maintain alignment across directors, tech leads, and cross-functional partners with authority and credibility.

What You’ll Need

Requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience, leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
Demonstrated experience owning Enterprise program strategy — including multi-year roadmap partnership, portfolio-level decision support, and org-wide process improvement — not just execution.
Significant experience in advertising technology, including ad-serving systems, real-time bidding, monetization platforms, data pipelines, and analytics systems.
Proficient architectural literacy across multiple platform programs; ability to guide teams toward scalable solutions and evaluate cross-program constraints and tradeoffs.
Executive-level communication skills; ability to craft scenario-based decision paths for senior engineering and business leadership and drive consensus through clarity.
Proven ability to drive delivery across tightly coupled, interdependent systems at scale.
Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal oversight across ambiguous, high-stakes programs.
Experience working across multiple Agile methodologies; proficiency with Jira and related program management tooling.
Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as chatGPT, Gemini, etc.
Strong propensity toward relationship building and influencing without authority.
Experience in digital audio or media platforms preferred.
Experience managing vendor or third-party technology integrations, including global or multi-region platforms preferred.
Experience in high-availability, real-time systems environments preferred.
Experience leading platform transformation or cross-organizational consolidation programs preferred.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $150,100 to $179,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Job Description

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager, Principal Sr. to lead the delivery of Nordstrom’s highest-impact cybersecurity programs — initiatives that protect the company’s customers, data, and operations across every technology and business function.

This senior-most individual contributor role sits within the CISO’s organization, at the intersection of security engineering, governance risk and compliance (GRC), and enterprise technology delivery. You will drive the programs that reduce Nordstrom’s risk posture at scale — partnering with security, platform, and business teams to plan, sequence, and execute complex, cross-functional security initiatives from charter through measurable outcome.

This is not a role for managing programs at arm’s length. It is a role for someone who translates security strategy into executable delivery plans, manages risk and dependencies across a portfolio of concurrent programs, holds partners accountable to commitments, and reports progress with rigor to senior leadership. You will operate with SVP/VP-level visibility and represent program delivery excellence for Nordstrom’s cybersecurity organization.

Key Responsibilities

Program Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

Own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of enterprise cybersecurity programs (e.g., identity and access management, cloud security, data protection, incident response, vulnerability management, third-party risk) spanning multiple teams and technology domains.
Translate security strategy and executive priorities into structured program charters, roadmaps, and delivery plans with clear scope, milestones, and success criteria.
Sequence and prioritize competing initiatives across the security portfolio based on risk reduction, business impact, and resource constraints.
Partner with the CISO’s leadership team to shape investment priorities and build/partner/buy decisions for major security initiatives.

Program Governance & Risk Management

Establish and run program governance — steering committees, checkpoints, and decision forums — that keep security programs on track and escalate issues before they become blockers.
Identify, track, and drive resolution of program risks, issues, and dependencies across security, engineering, legal, and business stakeholders.
Ensure programs comply with relevant regulatory, audit, and internal control requirements, partnering with GRC and compliance teams as needed.
Define and enforce delivery standards and program management best practices across the cybersecurity organization.

Cross-Functional Delivery & Stakeholder Alignment

Build and lead cross-functional program teams spanning security engineering, IT, platform, legal, privacy, and business units to execute enterprise-wide security initiatives.
Drive alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities, resolving conflicts and unblocking delivery through structured negotiation and clear articulation of tradeoffs.
Serve as the primary point of coordination between the cybersecurity organization and business/technology teams impacted by security programs, ensuring changes roll out with minimal disruption.
Partner with vendors and external partners supporting security program delivery, managing scope, timeline, and contractual commitments.

Metrics, Reporting & Executive Communication

Define program-level metrics and KPIs that demonstrate risk reduction, delivery velocity, and program health across the security portfolio.
Build and maintain dashboards and status reporting that give practitioners and senior leadership real-time visibility into program progress and risk.
Report program status, risks, and impact to VP/SVP-level and executive stakeholders with clarity, rigor, and actionable recommendations.
Use data and post-program retrospectives to continuously improve program delivery practices across the organization.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

Mentor and develop TPMs and program managers across the cybersecurity organization, raising the bar for program management rigor and delivery excellence.
Champion a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within the security program management discipline.
Represent the cybersecurity organization in enterprise-wide program management communities of practice.

YOU OWN THIS IF YOU HAVE…

12+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, with a significant portion managing complex, cross-functional cybersecurity, risk, or compliance programs.
Demonstrated ability to lead delivery of enterprise-scale security initiatives from strategy through execution, across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Working knowledge of core cybersecurity domains (e.g., identity and access management, cloud security, data protection, incident response, vulnerability management, third-party risk) sufficient to manage delivery credibly with technical stakeholders.
Experience establishing program governance, risk management, and reporting structures that hold cross-functional teams accountable to commitments.
A track record of navigating regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements within program delivery.
Systems-level thinking: ability to hold technical architecture, organizational dynamics, risk posture, and business strategy simultaneously.
Executive presence: experience influencing at the VP/SVP level with clarity, candor, and strong command of tradeoffs.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience required.

Job Description

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

Key Responsibilities

Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy

Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

Architecture and AI Deployment

Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

Automation Program Execution

Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting

Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Qualifications

10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

Required Skills And Competencies

Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

Role: - Senior Technical Project Manager, Windows Modernization

Location: - Remote, USA

Job Summary:

Provide senior, deeply technical project leadership for an enterprise Windows modernization effort. The role will translate endpoint-engineering strategy into an executable roadmap and coordinate engineering, security, identity, application, hardware, service management, and business teams through design, pilot, deployment, adoption, and stabilization.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the Windows modernization roadmap, integrated plan, deployment waves, dependencies, risks, governance, and success criteria.
• Partner closely with Windows endpoint engineering to coordinate architecture, management tooling, security baselines, identity, application compatibility, hardware readiness, and support processes.
• Lead discovery, current-state assessment, design decisions, pilot cohorts, test plans, deployment rings, rollback criteria, and enterprise rollout.
• Coordinate application owners, security, networking, identity, procurement, asset management, service desk, field support, and business stakeholders.
• Drive executive governance, technical decision forums, RAID management, milestone reporting, resource planning, and escalation.
• Ensure end-user communications, change adoption, training, knowledge transfer, documentation, and operational readiness are complete.
• Use data and deployment telemetry to identify risk, improve rollout quality, and drive corrective action.
Required Skills and Experience

• 8+ years of technical project or program management experience, including enterprise endpoint or Windows transformation programs.
• Strong technical experience with Windows endpoints, endpoint engineering, device management, security baselines, application compatibility, and deployment operations.
• Demonstrated delivery of Windows upgrades, modern management, endpoint security, device lifecycle, or large-scale workplace modernization.
• Ability to engage credibly with senior engineers and translate technical decisions into integrated delivery plans.

new_jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications

Master's degree, plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience. Bachelor's degree in a related specialized area or equivalent relevant experience is required, plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibilityrequirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S.citizenship is required.

Responsibilities For This Position

General Dynamics Mission Systems has an immediate opening for an Information Assurance Security Professional.This position provides an opportunity to further advance the cutting-edge technology that supports some of our nation’s core defense/intelligence services and systems. General Dynamics Mission Systems employees work closely with esteemed customers to develop solutions that allow them to carry out high-stakes national security missions.

The candidate will be designated as an Information System SecurityManager (ISSM) supporting multiple Special Access Programs administering the Information Assurance (IA) Cyber duties for government customers. Components of the IA program include Assessment and Authorization (A&A) activities (i.e., documentation preparation, system configuration/validation, certification testing), security sustainment activities (i.e., hardware change management, software change management, account management, media protection, user interface, file transfers), conducting self-inspections, audit trail review, and delivering information systems security education and awareness. The candidate must be a self-starter capable of multitasking and efficiently managing their time in a dynamic environment while requiring minimal levels of supervision. Additionally, the candidate will possess effective written, speaking, analytical, organizational, and customer service skills that will assist them in identifying solutions to complex compliance and security problems. The ISSM will coordinate duties with the System Administrators and/or Information Technology (IT) staff to ensure all configuration requirements are implemented and functional. The ISSM will conduct technical and nontechnical reviews and audits.

Imagine a world-class engineering environment. Now add a team of exceptional talent along with technologies that are so advanced they’re often classified. That’s what you’ll find at General Dynamics Mission Systems. Here you’ll lead amazing engineers as they invent the technologies, products and services that help our service members, intelligence analysts and first responders keep our nation safe. If you want the chance to lead, it’s time to bring your talent to General Dynamics Mission Systems.

We apply advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, AR/VR, Cloud Native and Quantum Physics to solve our customers’ missions in cyber, RF, undersea, interstellar and everything in between.

Providing security engineering and integration services to customers, you’ll develop and execute security controls, defenses and countermeasures to intercept and prevent internal or external attacks or attempts to infiltrate company email, data, e-commerce and web-based systems. You’ll also research attempted or successful efforts to compromise systems security and design countermeasures, maintain hardware, software and network firewalls and encryption protocols and administer security policies to control physical and virtual access to systems.

What you’ll experience:

Technologies that aren’t just top-notch, they’re often top-secret
A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered

What you bring to the table:

A Bachelor’s degree in a related specialized area or equivalent plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience
Ability to develop, test, debug and deploy code or processing routines that support security protocols for an established system or systems
Ability to apply current computer science technologies to the design, development, evaluation, and integration of computer systems and networks to maintain system security
Very strong knowledge of the following:
disaster recovery and continuity of operations plans
response and handling methodologies
resource management principles and techniques
server administration and systems engineering theories, concepts, and methods
system life cycle management principles, including software security and usability
information security program management and project management principles and techniques
network systems management principles, models, methods (e.g., end-to-end systems performance monitoring), and tools
security architecture concepts and enterprise architecture reference models
applicable business processes and operations of customer organizations
system software and organizational design standards, policies, and authorized approaches relating to system design

What sets you apart:

Creative thinking with the ability to multi-task
Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success
Commitment to ongoing professional development
Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

Target salary range: USD $132,859.00/Yr. - USD $140,000.00/Yr. This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!
