new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading client technology projects from internal handoff and initiation through planning, execution, acceptance, transition, and closeout. Operating in a fast-paced Value-Added Reseller (VAR), Managed Services Provider (MSP), and IT consulting environment, this role coordinates customers, engineers, vendors, procurement, sales, and managed services to deliver defined outcomes on time, within scope, and within approved financial parameters. The ideal candidate combines disciplined project governance with practical judgment, strong customer leadership, and enough technical fluency to manage infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, network, data center, and workplace technology initiatives. This position owns the project management process and project communication; technical design and engineering decisions remain with the assigned technical resources. Success requires consistent follow-up, early escalation, accurate records, and a strong commitment to customer experience and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Project Initiation & Planning

Lead the transition of sold work from Sales and Pre-Sales/Professional Services into delivery, confirming the statement of work, assumptions, exclusions, deliverables, acceptance criteria, budget, timeline, dependencies, and customer responsibilities before execution begins
Conduct project kickoff meetings and establish clear governance, stakeholder roles, communication cadence, escalation paths, decision authority, and working agreements
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, work breakdown structures, resource forecasts, and dependency maps appropriate to project size and complexity
Confirm that engineering resources, customer contacts, procurement requirements, licensing, equipment, site readiness, access, maintenance windows, and third-party dependencies are aligned before work is scheduled
Establish and maintain the project record, including project charter or initiation documentation, stakeholder register, baseline schedule, budget, RAID log, change log, decision log, and communications plan
Scope, Financial & Change Control
Risk, Issue & Quality Management
Customer & Stakeholder Management
Resource, Capacity & Cross-Functional Coordination
Documentation, Systems & Process Improvement

Project Execution & Delivery

Manage multiple concurrent client projects across infrastructure, networking, cloud, Microsoft 365, cybersecurity, storage, virtualization, data center, endpoint, and related professional services engagements
Coordinate day-to-day execution across engineers, customers, vendors, subcontractors, procurement, account management, and managed services while maintaining clear ownership of actions and deadlines
Facilitate status meetings, working sessions, readiness reviews, cutover planning, and post-implementation reviews; distribute concise notes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates promptly
Track progress against the approved baseline, identify schedule or delivery variance, and drive corrective actions without assuming technical ownership that belongs to engineering
Ensure customer decisions, technical prerequisites, access requirements, approvals, deliverables, and acceptance evidence are secured at the appropriate stage of the project
Coordinate change windows, implementation communications, rollback planning, and business-impact awareness with technical leads and customer stakeholders

Required Experience & Education

5+ years of project management experience, including responsibility for customer-facing IT infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, network, or professional services projects; VAR, MSP, systems integrator, or IT consulting experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities, shared technical resources, external dependencies, and customer-facing deadlines
Working knowledge of predictive, agile, and hybrid project delivery approaches and the judgment to scale governance to the size, risk, and complexity of the engagement
Experience managing scope, schedules, budgets, labor forecasts, risks, issues, changes, vendors, customer communications, and formal project closeout
Information Technology, Project Management, Management Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education, certification, and relevant experience will be considered

Preferred Project Management Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strongly preferred
Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) may be considered for candidates with strong directly relevant IT project experience who are actively progressing toward PMP certification
PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PRINCE2, or comparable agile/project delivery certification is beneficial
ITIL Foundation or comparable IT service management certification is beneficial, particularly for projects transitioning into managed services

About Ardham Technologies

Ardham Technologies is headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, and is experiencing rapid growth throughout the Southwest and Texas regions. As an exciting and innovative technology company, Ardham Technologies is dedicated to powering clients into the future of IT through comprehensive managed services and cutting-edge technology solutions. Our mission is to transform how organizations approach their technology infrastructure by delivering innovative managed offerings that drive business success. With our expanding presence across multiple markets, we provide our team members with exceptional opportunities for professional growth while working with diverse clients across various industries. Join Ardham Technologies and be part of a dynamic team that's shaping the future of managed IT services in one of the fastest-growing technology markets in the country.

Program Manager – Simulator Deployment and Sustainment
Job Description
Position Summary
The Program Manager is the senior frontline management position responsible for leading a team of Deputy Program Managers, Product Support Specialists and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) for a multi-year program delivering training simulators to a national footprint of US Government facilities. This role focuses on the overall program health and performance ensuring the firm-fixed price program is delivered on time, within budget, and to customer satisfaction. This program carries significant contract value, hardware and software procurement, configuration-managed baselines, and milestone deadlines with direct schedule, financial, and liquidated-damages accountability.
While the Program Manager role primary focus is to lead a strategically important program, there is also emphasis on team leadership, portfolio oversight, resource allocation, and alignment with organizational objectives. The Program Manager serves as a key link between program execution and executive leadership, and as a senior point of contact for prime contractors, Government stakeholders, and end customers on a high-consequence program.
Responsibilities
Direct Program Management
• Directly manage strategically important program with national multi-site rollouts under firm-fixed-price terms.
• Provide hands-on program leadership during critical phases, installations, test events, or resource constraints.
• Own scope, schedule, cost, and quality on assigned programs and manage milestone deadlines where slips carry contractual, financial, and liquidated-damages exposure.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
• Serves as the senior customer-facing point of contact; running program reviews, IPRs, and customer briefings
• Manage customer expectations and satisfaction through installation and site activation.
• Handle change requests, exceptions, and scope conversations with the prime and the Government.
• Build long-term customer relationships that position follow-on work and option-year exercise.
• Align project/program priorities with organizational strategy and objectives.
• Communicate program status, risks, and strategic issues to executive leadership.
• Serve as an escalation point for critical customer issues and program decisions.
• Interface with prime contractors and Government stakeholders, managing flow-down obligations, submittals, approvals, and deliverable commitments.
Program Oversight & Project Health
• Monitor the health, status, and performance within the program, including multi-site national deployments and long-duration programs with option years.
• Review project schedules, budgets, and risk profiles to identify issues requiring intervention.
• Ensure consistent application of project management, systems engineering, test and evaluation, and configuration management (CCB-governed baseline) methodologies and standards.
Cost, Schedule & Procurement Management
• Oversee cost and schedule baselines, applying earned value and other performance measures to keep firm-fixed-price program within budget.
• Guide management of Other Direct Costs, including procurement, vendor coordination, and supply-chain risk.
• Ensure integrated master schedule is maintained and that critical-path risks to installation, testing, and site activation are identified and mitigated early.
• Oversee contract deliverables required for the prime contractor to meet its obligations to the customer.
Resource & Capacity Management
• Allocate project management resources based on project priorities to identify capacity constraints.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams (development, systems engineering, test and evaluation, installation, and operations and maintenance) to ensure adequate staffing and support for project delivery.
Team Leadership & Development
• Directly manage and supervise Deputy Program Managers, Product Support Specialists and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and career development discussions with direct reports.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and guidance on project management best practices.
• Identify training needs and support professional development of team members.
• Foster a collaborative team environment and promote knowledge sharing across the organization.
• Participate in hiring, onboarding, and resource planning.
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Aviation, Business, or related field.
• 15+ years of experience in program or project management, including large-scale, multi-site technical systems.
• 5+ years of experience in a management or team leadership capacity, leading project managers or technical leads.
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
• Demonstrated experience delivering firm-fixed-price programs of significant value (multi-million dollar) with multi-year periods of performance and option years.
• Experience as a subcontractor program manager interfacing with a prime contractor and a Government end customer, including managing flow-down requirements and deliverables.
• Strong understanding of systems engineering, test and evaluation, and configuration management / controlled baselines (CCB) processes.
• Experience with cost and schedule control, including integrated master scheduling.
• Experience managing milestone-driven contracts, including risk and issue management under schedule, financial, and liquidated-damages accountability.
• Experience with project management and work management tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA), and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio).
• Strong leadership, coaching, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.
• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Position of Public Trust Clearance.
• Must be able to comply with U.S. trade and export-control requirements (ITAR, EAR, OFAC, FTR).
• Must be a U.S. citizen.
Preferred Qualifications
• MBA or Master’s degree in engineering, management, or a related field.
• Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification.

• Direct experience on U.S. Government programs, including FAA or National Airspace System (NAS) programs.
Working knowledge of ATC concepts, airfield/tower operations, and simulation/training environments.

Job Overview

The Implementation Services team is the technical and project management engine of findhelp’s Customer Success organization. As we continue to mature and scale our delivery model, we ensure that standard and mid-market customer launches are executed with high technical precision and operational consistency.

As an Implementation Manager, you will execute established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and leverage technical documentation to onboard customers efficiently. From the moment a contract is signed, you own the core customer journey—navigating a portfolio of standard implementations to deliver 'Initial Value' with speed and precision. This role is built for an organized, detail-oriented, and technically minded professional who thrives on executing structured project plans to deliver seamless onboarding experiences.

Project Ownership: Own the "Sales-to-Service" handoff, serving as the primary point of contact and lead for the full implementation lifecycle across a diverse portfolio.

Reporting: Develop and maintain 30/60/90-day progress reports to provide leadership with transparent visibility into portfolio health and Time-to-Value (TTV) metrics.
Quality & Readiness: Complete Go-Live Readiness Assessments prior to launch to ensure core technical and operational configuration is sound, executing structured internal handoffs to the ongoing Customer Success Manager.

3+ years of demonstrated success in implementation, Customer Success, project management, or technical project management within a SaaS or equivalent industry.
Expertise in Project Management: Strong execution skills using project management methodologies and tracking tools.
Technical Fluency: Ability to learn, understand, and translate standard system workflows into data integration configurations for diverse client structures, including proficiency in using generative, specifically Gemini to summarize information, draft communications, and enhance research efficiency.

Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our people apply undaunted curiosity, relentless ambition and boundless imagination to challenge convention and drive progress. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.

Amentum is soliciting applications for the position of Criminal Intelligence Analyst (Open Source Intelligence), supporting the Boston Regional Intelligence Center’s (BRIC’s) counterterrorism mission through a current contract.

Roles And Responsibilities

Work entails supporting law enforcement investigations and a broad range of analytic priorities focused on matters pertaining to terrorism, violent extremism, and threats to life and property. This position demands substantial attention to detail; exceptional analytical skills; strong writing, briefing and communication skills; proactive work ethic; knowledge of data analysis tools; strong information coordination skills; and the capability to collaborate in a team environment. Strong competency navigating the Internet, to include open source/social media content providers and platforms, as well as Boston Police Department-specific tools. This position will operate under strict legal guidelines to ensure the protection of privacy, civil rights and civil liberties of the public and all other constitutional protections.

Responsibilities include analyzing Internet/computer/cyber-based information sources and the contents of open-source platforms to identify threats to public safety and emerging risks to the Metro Boston region and supporting law enforcement investigations. Developing real time open-source intelligence from publicly available information sources by conducting analyses of threatening materials and/or behaviors, or information indicative to risks to public safety, that deliver actionable insights and contribute to the tactical and strategic operational needs of the BRIC. Maintain a keen understanding of computer/cyber-based criminal modus operandi, publicly available open source media, internet technologies, and modern communication and social networking environments. Adhering to a persistent analysis schedule; liaising with various units within in the Boston Police Department, as well as other local, state and federal law enforcement agencies; applying qualitative/quantitative analytical techniques to interpret findings; quickly learning informal communication methods, slang, or intentionally cryptic languages; dynamically adapting work responsibilities to a diverse array of priority information needs; working independently; remaining focused under pressure; and reading and reacting quickly, accurately, and professionally within a fast-paced environment.

Must stay current with the latest open-source analytic and investigative tradecraft, methodologies, technologies, and programs relating to real time open-source analysis. Responsible for supporting the BRIC’s use of open source/cyber analysis tools, developing innovative programming and analytical techniques to enhance open-source research and analysis, and revealing and addressing deficiencies in open source/cyber analysis capabilities.

Desired Skills

Strong understanding of privacy, civil rights and civil liberties issues as they pertain to the intelligence cycle within local law enforcement and an intelligence fusion center environment
Ability to work well within a team environment
Ability to maintain focus under pressure
Analytic experience within a local, state, or federal law enforcement agency and/or state/major urban area fusion center
Subject matter expertise in matters pertaining to behavioral threat assessment, various international and domestic terrorism ideologies, and violent extremism
Strong writing and briefing skills
Experience writing intelligence assessments for intelligence community or law enforcement consumers
Understanding of the Nationwide Suspicious Activity Reporting Initiative
Experience performing tactical intelligence analysis in support of criminal investigations
Multilingual skills – especially, multilingual reading and writing proficiency

Required Qualifications

Education: High School Diploma / GED Minimum
Relevant Experience: Nine (9) years’ experience with a high school diploma / GED or four (4) years’ experience with a bachelor’s degree or two (2) years’ experience with a master’s degree
Candidates are required to pass a background check, to include a drug test, with the Boston Police Department as a condition of employment and must be able to obtain and maintain a national security clearance at the Top-Secret level. Please note U.S. Citizenship is required to obtain and maintain a Top-secret clearance.

Minimum Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Computer skills required: MS Office Suite skills
Ability to work effectively and efficiently in a team environment and relate well to others
Ability to show initiative and commitment to the company’s goals
Ability to readily adapt to changing requirements
Strong commitment to performing and producing at the highest level of quality at all times
Ability to manage individual workflow effectively and improve processes when necessary
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with coworkers both in written and verbal communications
Positive attitude focused on customer satisfaction

Work Environment:

This position is performed in a traditional office environment.

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand and/or walk; handle or feel objects; and write. Ability to bend, reach, lift, and carry up to 15 pounds

Compensation Details:

$85,000-$90,000

The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.

Benefits Overview:

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off and holidays
Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)
Educational reimbursement
Parental leave
Employee stock purchase plan
Tax-saving options
Disability and life insurance
Pet insurance

Note: Benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and applicable agreements. Positions governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA), or other employment contracts may include different provisions/benefits.

new_jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst - Mail Fraud
new_jobs.description:
Title: Intelligence Analyst -Mail Fraud

Location: Fairfax, Virginia

Security Clearance: Secret/TS Preferred

Schedule: Due to the nature of law enforcement work and operation, position may require occasional support outside of core working hours, as well as intermittent weekend support, mission dependent

Salary: $90,000-95,000/Annually

Level: ISA II-A

Division: Mail Fraud

About KACE

KACE delivers technology-enabled mission services that advance public health, public safety, and national security, combining our large-scale operational capabilities with advanced technologies and data insights to meet the government’s most complex challenges.

At KACE, purpose and service are at the heart of everything we do, and every role plays a part in the mission. Our employees bring a wide range of skills, experiences, and perspectives to the critical government operations we support, making a measurable impact every day. This is purpose-driven work, and we are committed to delivering a workforce that is mission-focused, accountable, and dedicated to advancing the nation’s safety, security, and performance.

We’re proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work! This is an honor that reflects the voices of our employees and the culture we’ve built together. This certification recognizes our commitment to creating an inclusive, supportive, and engaging workplace where employees feel valued, heard, and empowered. At KACE, being a Great Place to Work means we prioritize professional growth, celebrate achievements, encourage collaboration, and foster an environment where innovation thrives.

The KACE Way is our commitment to our employees, to our customers, and to our communities. Join KACE and make a difference!

Job Summary

The Intelligence Analyst supports the United States Postal Inspection Service’s criminal programs involving mail fraud, financial crimes, money laundering and organized criminal enterprises. The position will be co-located with the Homeland Security Taskforce (HSTF) assisting the Mail Fraud Program involving fraud initiatives, complaints, and other HSTF Analysts by providing analysis, assessments, and investigation deconfliction services as part of an interagency team. The analyst shall be capable of using technology solutions to actively search, analyze, prioritize, and present information for criminal investigators.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

General knowledge of federal statutes and the federal rules of criminal and civil procedure.
Demonstrated experience developing and supporting complex fraud and financial criminal cases for prosecution.
Proficient in conducting research using the internet and other commercial/public/proprietary databases
Substantial experience in analyzing data and interpreting patterns or trends using the appropriate analytical techniques and methods.
Ability to communicate orally and in writing to clearly explain analytical steps taken, additional investigative actions needed, and summarizing results of research and analysis using multiple mediums such as charts and reports.
Demonstrated significant ability developing and supporting the final work product.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team with proven ability to influence across functions and discipline.
Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks with competing priorities and meet deliverables.
Proficiency using Microsoft Office products (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint), sufficient to compile data, prepare correspondence and presentations.

Work Duties and Tasks

Reviews and triages fraud complaints in various databases.
Analyzes complaint data and trends for further analysis and/or dissemination to the appropriate areas.
Performs liaison activities with other law enforcement agencies to identify targets, deconflict investigative activities, and provide collaboration across agencies.
Analyze data to identify and interpret patterns and trends, assess data quality, and eliminate irrelevant data.
Evaluates information from a variety of sources to determine criminal activity, conducts analysis, and presents findings.
Identifies illicit activities of bad actors and performs linkage analysis utilizing task force collaboration to determine of the organization’s network based on heuristic models and other datasets.
Evaluates and combine tools such as enhanced open source, commercial data, and government data sources to assist in development of lead-based information and identification of assets involving money laundering activities.
Analyze, develop, and disseminate intelligence such as threat reports, lead, subject and target packages to benefit operators and investigators.
Communicate analytical findings, trends, and other issues affecting the Inspection Service (IS) to the appropriate IS Program Managers. This may be in the form of formal/standardized reports, in person briefings, regularly scheduled meetings, and/or ad hoc request for information.

Minimum Qualifications & Skills

A Bachelor’ Degree from an accredited college or university AND a minimum of (5) five years of work experience in a law enforcement intelligence unit environment.
Significant demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of the education requirement.

Clearance

Applicants selected may be subject to a government background investigation and may be required to meet the following conditions of employment.

Security Requirements/Background Investigation Requirements

Must be a U.S Citizen.
Favorable credit check for all cleared positions
Successfully passing a background investigation including drug screening.
Residency requirement - 3 consecutive years in the last 5 years.

Physical Requirements/Working Conditions

Standing/Walking/Mobility: Must have mobility to attend meetings with other managers and employees.
Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: 10% of the time.
Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: 10%
Fingering/Grasping/Feeling: Must be able to write, type, and use a telephone system 100% of the time.
Sitting: Sitting for prolonged and extended periods of time.

This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may revise duties as necessary without updating this job description.

new_jobs.description:
About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description:

The Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt (12 month Contract)
will report directly to the Director, Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with a background in Data Science or Data Analytics who is looking to develop their career in an entrepreneurial and high-energy environment. Embedded within the business, this role supports management reporting, forecasting, and portfolio analysis across the RE Debt portfolio, in addition to being the primary liaison to ED&A and IT — translating reporting requirements into data specifications and building data flows from the Enterprise Data Platform through to the reporting layer. This position also works closely with the Real Estate Debt Investment, Accounting, and Operations teams, FP&A, and Portfolio Management teams across QuadReal.

Role Description:

Support scenario modelling, cash flow forecasting, leverage and liquidity analysis through Anaplan, supplemented by ad-hoc financial models as needed, using AI-assisted development for efficiency and quality control
Analyze portfolio exposures, return attribution, and market trends, and support the development of presentation materials with AIenhanced insights and visualization
Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and ad hoc management reports for senior management, Board of Directors and BCI
Support real estate debt investment underwriting by providing portfolio impact analysis
Assist with ad hoc research projects for benchmarking, peer analysis, risk analysis, and other relevant topics
Query and extract data from enterprise data platforms to support portfolio reporting and analytics needs
Develop and maintain business logic, portfolio calculations, and data transformation rules that underpin reporting outputs
Serve as the primary business-side liaison to IT and ED&A, translating reporting requirements into data specifications and validating platform outputs
Support data enablement initiatives and ongoing data management and governance priorities across the RE Debt portfolio
Validate and reconcile data collected from different systems using AI-powered anomaly detection to improve data quality and identify process improvement opportunities

Experience And Qualifications:

University degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field) OR a background in Economics, Finance or a related business field. CFA or similar designation is a plus
2–3 years of experience working in a data analyst role, ideally in investment management or real estate.
Analytical – Strong quantitative and analytical skills; detail-oriented and proficient in building and handling complicated data sets.
Excellent communication and presentation skills; demonstrates an ability to effectively communicate and present results that articulate key themes and messages.
Must be able to allocate time effectively and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines, handle multiple demands and competing priorities, and adapt to new ideas and change. Comfortable following direction but also contributing to the direction.
Advanced knowledge of SQL, Power Query, Excel, and Power BI is required. Familiarity with Anaplan or a similar planning tool is an asset. Experience with Tableau or Python is considered a plus.
Proactive approach to leveraging technology for process improvement and analytical enhancement. Comfortable learning and applying new tools, automation techniques, GenAI applications (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot), and advanced analytics platforms to solve complex problems, automate data analysis, rapidly prototype financial models, and deliver higher-quality insights.
Has a questioning frame of mind, asks “why” and challenges the status quo with improvements to drive change when needed.

The expected annualized base salary range for this role is $74,000-$84,000.

The actual salary offered will take into consideration a wide array of factors including, but not limited to, the individual’s skill, experience, education and training, the market compensation of the role, and the consideration to internal equity.

We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Even if your skills don’t align 100% with the listed qualifications or salary range, we encourage you to apply – you may be a great fit for this role or others in our community. Applicants may also be considered for alternative positions within the organization where their qualifications and experience align more closely with available opportunities.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) technology — alongside human review — to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position. Our recruitment team remains involved in all decisions.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada as the company does not provide work permit sponsorship for this role.

Note to Recruiters: QuadReal does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to QuadReal, directly or indirectly, will be considered QuadReal property. QuadReal will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for engaged services to submit resumes.

QuadReal Property Group will provide reasonable accommodation at any time throughout the hiring process for applicants with disabilities or for those needing job postings in an alternate format. If you require accommodation, please advise the Talent Acquisition team member you are working with and include the following: Job posting #, your name and your preferred method of contact.

As a member of the Cyber Threat Unit, this position is responsible for the proactive assessment and analysis of cyber risk, understanding threats as they relate to the organization, responding to cyber incidents, and implementing measures to prevent or combat existing and potential threats.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor and analyze network traffic, Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP) events, security events and logs.
Perform secondary reviews and maintain Data Loss Prevention (DLP) systems and policies.
Understand a variety of security and compliance policies and incident response processes.
Review daily reports and files to ensure compliance to policies and standards.
Escalate non-compliance issues to the appropriate group and follow-up on remediation actions
Work with internal customers to respond to escalations.
Prioritize and differentiate between potential intrusion attempts and false alarms.
Determine if security events monitored should be escalated to incidents and follow all applicable incident response and reporting processes and procedures.
Create and track security investigations to resolution.
Open and assign tickets to the correct resolver, and validate/close tickets related to false positives.
Provide investigation, triage, and mitigation of detected security events.
Compose security alert notifications and other communications.
Advise incident responders in the steps to take to investigate and resolve computer security incidents.
Stay up to date with current vulnerabilities, attacks, and countermeasures.
Work closely with the SNOC 24x7 operations team, network and system administrators, other appropriate IT/IS groups and business lines to provide incident response (IR) support and determine the risk of a given event.
Implement and monitor controls necessary to ensure processes are performed and are effective to protect the environment from all forms of malicious cyber activity.
Conduct Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) analysis of suspected compromised systems.
Assist in establishing procedures for handling each security event detected.
Keep abreast of emerging technology and public policy trends in the information security space.
Assist in the gathering and analysis of the current and future threat landscape, and assist the SNOC Manager in providing leadership with a realistic overview of risks and threats in and to the organization.
Maintain knowledge of the current security threat level by monitoring related threat intelligence sources as necessary.
Utilize intelligence provided by the Threat Intelligence team from past or current events to improve detection, update monitoring and possibly facilitate prevention of successful cyber attacks.
Provide advice on IT initiatives, IT business projects, and IT engineering in regards to security industry best practices.
Adheres to and complies with applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to anti-money laundering (i.e. Bank Secrecy Act, US PATRIOT Act, etc.).
Adheres to Bank policies and procedures and completes required training.
Identifies and reports suspicious activity.

Job Description

Who We Are:

Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and the only one primarily managed by researchers. Ranked the #1 Most Innovative Market Research Supplier by Greenbook’s GRIT report for four consecutive years, we operate in 90 markets, offer more than 75 data-driven solutions, and serve over 5,000 clients worldwide. Our research, methodological, implementation, and subject matter experts help organizations solve complex business challenges through data-driven insights and evidence-based decision-making. We're proud to have been named one of Forbes' America's Best Employers for Company Culture in 2025, Forbes' America's Best Employers for Women in 2026 and recognized by Newsweek as one of the World’s Most Trustworthy Companies in 2026.

We are looking for someone who is deeply curious about people, brands, and business growth. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys asking questions, solving problems, uncovering patterns in data, and translating insights into action. This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for someone who is interested in starting a career in market research.

About Brand Health Tracking

Brand building drives business growth by strengthening relationships with consumers, building desire over time. The Brand Health Tracking Service Line at Ipsos helps clients understand how people feel about their brands, tracks changes in performance over time, and provides insight into how advertising may be influencing consumer attitudes towards clients’ brands.

What makes this role important at Ipsos?

As part of the Brand Health Tracking team, you'll help some of Canada's leading organizations understand what drives brand performance and business growth. Working across categories including financial services, retail, telecommunications, technology, travel, QSR, CPG, and healthcare, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of business challenges, consumer behaviours, and growth opportunities.

You'll work day-to-day with data to uncover meaningful insights, collaborate across teams to solve client challenges, and develop the skills needed to become a trusted advisor. This role combines analytical thinking, problem solving, project management, and communication, providing a strong foundation for a career in brand strategy, insights, and advisory.

As you build your experience, your role can evolve beyond project execution. You'll have opportunities to contribute to client discussions, help synthesize and present findings, and support recommendations that influence business, brand, and marketing decisions. Over time, you'll develop the skills, confidence, and commercial perspective needed to become a trusted advisor to some of Canada's leading brands, helping turn consumer understanding into actions that drive growth.

What You Can Expect To Be Doing

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - New Platform Validation Operations
new_jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo Operations exists to deliver the Waymo Driver to the world. We are a global team building and scaling the world's first and leading autonomous fleet and operations platform. From component sourcing to end customer management, we enable and create value for Waymo through scaled and orchestrated deployment of the Waymo Driver. At Waymo, we are dedicated to building a culture that promotes collaboration and celebration. We value our team members' unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences and support and encourage all team members to share their ideas to help Waymo better serve the communities in which we operate.

In this hybrid role, you will report to a Head of Validation Operations

You Will

Lead NPI Platform Program Execution: Drive end-to-end program structuring for onboarding new platform variants into validation fleets, managing the critical path from arrival and upfit to testing and fleet deployment.
Executive Stakeholder Management & Influence: Serve as the primary operational partner to cross-functional leadership (Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Safety), actively aligning dependencies, pushing back when necessary, and driving high-level decisions.
Hands-on Operational Problem Solving: Bridge high-level program strategy with ground-level realities, stepping directly into depot/field operations as needed to unblock issues and validate processes.
Align Planning with Execution: Spearhead operating plans that reconcile demand forecasts with field realities, dynamically adjusting for real-time vehicle online rates, upfit throughput, and operator constraints.
Executive Reporting & Visibility: Formulate, automate, and present executive dashboards and operating metrics, effectively communicating operational readiness, program risks, and fleet bottlenecks to senior leadership.
Optimize Fleet Efficiency & Yield: Partner cross-functionally to build capacity and forecasting frameworks that maximize validation yield and streamline vendor operational workflows.

You Have

Operational & Program Leadership: 7–10+ years of experience leading complex technical programs or physical operations, with a proven ability to structure ambiguous initiatives from concept to execution.
Executive Presence & Communication: Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, communicate trade-offs clearly to executive leadership, and manage high-stakes cross-functional relationships.
Hands-on / "Scrappy" Mindset: Willingness to engage directly with ground-level depot workflows and physical hardware when technical roadblocks require operational triage.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Proven track record aligning cross-functional teams (Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Safety, Legal) across shifting timelines and competing priorities.

We Prefer

Hardware / NPI Testing Experience: Direct experience launching or validating automotive, autonomous vehicle, or robotics hardware platforms.
Vendor & Field Operations: Experience managing third-party vendor operations, staffing models, or depot operations.

Travel Requirements

15–30% Domestic/International Travel: Required in addition to regular local depot and site visits.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$190,000—$234,000 USD

PROENERGY is an engineering, R&D, and manufacturing powerhouse. The company addresses every need for fast-start power generation: turbine and package manufacturing, turnkey project execution, power purchase agreements, and asset lifecycle care for turbines and plants. Where others see impossible energy challenges, PROENERGY provides innovative aeroderivative solutions.

Our Footprint

PROENERGY delivers fast-start, dispatchable power solutions from worldwide centers for aeroderivative excellence. We are investing more than $1 billion through 2028 in infrastructure to serve our customers.

In Sedalia, Missouri,
our 600,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Manufacturing—a world-class investment in fast-start power and the only campus of its kind in the world—is growing by 40 percent.

In Houston, Texas,
our 500,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Lifecycle Care features a Level-IV depot and aero repair facility, which executes comprehensive services for aeroderivative engines under one roof.

In Kansas City

And our worldwide service centers

Our Philosophy

We take care of our people and strive to make a positive difference for the world. The Development Project Manager responsibilities will provide primary support and leadership to the WattBridge objective of providing power generation and data center campuses that consists of 1.5 GW’s commissioned by 2029 as part of a to be developed 5 GW portfolio. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Media
is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month.

AdsWizz
, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, Ad Technology, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership.
Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.
Advocate for program(s) health and long-term strategy.

Organizational Effectiveness & Governance

Define and institutionalize Ads TPM org-wide program governance standards, operating models, and best practices, elevating execution rigor across the entire Ads Engineering organization.
Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.
Continuously improve governance and delivery processes to increase predictability, execution quality, and program health over time.
Establish and facilitate team-level ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and/or other meetings needed to ensure smooth execution and team alignment.
Partner with TPM leadership to run program level ceremonies like intake and refinement if required.
Define, instrument, and socialize delivery and operational health metrics (e.g., predictability, cycle time, throughput, readiness, and post-launch outcomes) to drive transparent decision-making and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication

Build formal cross-functional networks across Product, Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and partner programs to drive alignment and coordinated execution; influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leadership.
Serve as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, and external stakeholders.
Present clear, scenario-based decision paths to engineering and business leadership, driving consensus through clarity.
Resolve conflict and maintain alignment across directors, tech leads, and cross-functional partners with authority and credibility.

What You’ll Need

Requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience, leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives.

What You'll Do At H1

As a Sr. Implementation Manager, you will work directly with customers to deliver solutions that are transforming the healthcare landscape. You’ll sit at the intersection of Professional Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering, ensuring customers experience smooth, high-quality delivery while driving operational excellence across the services organization. This is a hands-on role combining project ownership, cross-functional coordination, and team advocacy, with meaningful visibility and impact.

You will:

Build and manage project plans to drive implementing and/or migrating the H1 solution(s) to our customers
Develop, iterate on or inform processes to create operational efficiencies within the services organization
Lead high visibility H1 initiated projects that impact customers and require both internal and external planning and communication
Be the point of contact for the CSM to get project updates from Product/Engineering
Manage customer deliverables against Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Partner with Customer Success to ensure high degree of customer satisfaction is achieved through delivery process
Partner with Product & Engineering to share customer feedback and help inform product initiatives
Partner with additional internal teams to collaborate and be the voice on the implementation team in cross-functional and strategic meetings

About You

You’re a confident, approachable leader who thrives in complexity and enjoys solving ambiguous problems. You balance strong project management discipline with excellent communication and relationship-building skills, and you know how to influence without authority in a fast-moving environment.

You have a natural ownership mindset and take pride in delivering results
You’re comfortable leading high-stakes, customer-facing initiatives
You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally and translating technical updates into clear, actionable insights
You’ve brought structure to ambiguity and stay calm under pressure
You’re energized by building and improving processes that scale

Requirements

5+ years of project management experience
2+ years of experience implementing SaaS or data solutions in the healthcare space
Effective communication and presentation skills, and the ability to successfully communicate with a variety of levels within an organization
Track record of success in a results-driven, fast-paced environment
Demonstrate grit, resilience and tenacity with a desire to succeed on your own terms scaling with the company as we grow

Compensation

This role pays $115,000 to $140,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units.

new_jobs.title: Health & Wellbeing Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal.
That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

This is a remote position supporting a major retail client. Candidates are required to be available during Pacific Standard Time business hours and support onsite events as needed.

The Health & Wellbeing Program Manager is a client-dedicated member of the Personify Health account team, focused on designing and delivering a comprehensive strategic wellbeing plan, aimed at building a culture of health, enhancing health and wellbeing engagement, and driving health behavior change through awareness and activation. The Health & Wellbeing Program Manager works side by side with the Personify Health account leadership and the client’s HR, benefits, and/or stakeholder teams. This individual will provide advocacy for Personify Health products while embracing Personify Health’s mission and values. This position may include approximately 10-15% travel.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities/Duties

Provide direction and subject matter expertise in defining, designing, developing, communicating, and executing a comprehensive health and wellbeing strategy
Utilize project management skills to develop and execute health and wellbeing programs according to timeline and budget
Monitor, evaluate, and respond to program measurements and participant feedback, including operations and quality, to drive continuous quality improvement initiatives and goals
Serve as an integrated partner and the face of wellbeing to the client population, guiding members to appropriate resources and programs
Serve as a Personify Health platform expert, with deep knowledge in customizing the platform experience locally and delivering custom engagement initiatives; Deliver product demos as needed to drive enrollment and engagement
Engage and partner with client leadership, stakeholders and internal groups (Diversity & Inclusion, Employee Resource Groups, etc…) to build and support a culture of health
Leverage community partnerships to support client goals including initiatives related to social determinants of health, diversity and inclusion, health, and holistic wellbeing (mental, physical, social, community, financial, and safety wellbeing)
Collaborate with Personify Health and the client’s health plan and vendor partners to identify opportunities for health awareness and engagement, and to drive utilization of the client’s suite of health, benefits, and wellbeing programs
Launch and lead a Wellness Champion Network
Lead implementation of health promotion programs including health screenings, flu shots, and open enrollment events
Lead regular data assessment and reporting to internal and external stakeholders and leadership, while defining opportunities, tracking impact, and determining next best steps
Confidence in working with a potentially global population and understanding cultural nuances; adept at adapting the wellbeing program to meet diverse needs
Perform other related duties as assigned

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in health promotion or other health related field such as public health, community health, nutrition, exercise physiology, etc…
Master’s degree in Public Health or related field preferred
Public health related certification (ie: CHES, NWI, Chapman Institute) preferred
5+ years of experience in fields related to health and wellbeing
5+ years of experience in corporate environment preferred
Experience working with incentive programs; working knowledge of the Personify Health platform and systems/tools preferred
Health plan experience preferred

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to identify processes and organize resources to coordinate and execute multiple projects simultaneously
Skilled project manager with the ability to manage tasks, timelines and collaborate across departments to communicate and execute projects successfully
Strong technical acumen with the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly
Excellent time management
Strong business acumen
Ability to operate successfully in a matrixed environment including relationship management among multiple stakeholders and decision makers; ability to navigate client business needs alongside Personify Health business needs
Self-starter, entrepreneurial mindset
Outstanding written and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to create impactful and engaging content
Detail oriented with thoroughness and accuracy when accomplishing a task, while demonstrating concern for all areas involved
Outstanding ability to deliver presentations at all levels of an organization, including C-Suite leadership, and to diverse audiences and groups, via multiple modalities including virtually and in-person, when appropriate
Strong customer service orientation and relationship management
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
Naturally curious

Work Environment

At Personify Health we value and celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to change lives for the good.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities, but constitutes a general description of the scope and function of the role within the company. Activities, duties, and responsibilities are subject to change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits

The Highlights:

Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture?
Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation:
This position offers a base salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment:
Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe:
Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to talent@personifyhealth.com . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers .
